02-welcome-pack.verdict: The new card is cleaner and more consistent, with an x, one lime action, tiles, rarity bars and no explaining text. It is still a plain list in a mostly empty card, with undersized text and a weak hero.
findings: P1 item rows, 1080 card: Set names to 20px f-cond 600 and counts to 20px tx-1 in a fixed-width column, with the x in tx-2. Put the counts directly after the name, or use a 2-column tile grid. Give the rare gun a larger tile or an --r-rare name colour so one row clearly leads.

P1 layout, whole card: Make the card 90% wide and about 85% tall, with 2 columns of 96px tiles (guns on the left, consumables on the right). Or keep the card narrow and drop the empty space with a 40px bottom padding.
P1 item tiles: Draw icons at 48px inside a 72px tile. Delete the pip blocks or turn them into a real number. Set the tile border colour to the rarity colour.
P2 rarity bars: Move the bar to the tile's left edge at full row height (72px), or colour the tile border. Make the rare and uncommon bars 4px wide so they stay distinct from common.
P2 close x, top right: Use a 40px x with a 2px stroke in tx-1, a --ui-raised fill on hover, and a lime focus ring. Show the b/esc hint at 14px beside it.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The new floor has a clear hierarchy, with a lime 'enter raid!' and quiet station chips, and the title now sits in a real panel. It still reads as a debug-looking overlay, though, because of the 'experimental' banner with its stars, the tiny 14-16px text, the exclamation mark and the loose key-hint chips.
findings: P1 the last pour station, '***experimental feature may glitch***' tag: Delete the sentence. If a warning is needed, use a 16px '--warn' amber 'beta' tag inside the name chip, with no asterisks.

P1 station name chips (wirt the gambler, shop craft and hire, settings, the stash, fashion): Set station names to 20px f-cond 600 at the 16px minimum, with 8px/16px padding. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a key chip ('e') on the nearest station only, to create focus.
P1 enter raid! chip: Use --fs-title 32px f-cond 800 in --acc on a --ui-panel chip with a 3px lime bottom bar. Drop the '!' and say 'enter raid'. Add the 'e' key chip.

P2 bottom hint stack (welcome toast + wasd/shift/e legend) above the hotbar: Remove the welcome sentence, or auto-dismiss it after 4s. Make the legend one 16px row, with 16px gaps and the same --ui-panel fill and border as the other chips. Keep a 16px clearance above the hotbar.

P2 top-left title panel 'the undercroft': Align it to the 96px (5%) margin to match the top-right group. Drop the repeated sub-line, or set it to 16px --tx-2. Make the panel height match the top-right currency row.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: Fresh critic on HEAD v34.33 (job 108): 3. The 10-20 score of 2 was stale. Left: the empty left pane (P0), the gun keys block and the header figures (P1).
findings: P0 right pane, gun keys / item wheel block (y 640-890): Collapse gun keys and item wheel into one tabbed or toggled sub-panel. Alternatively give each a 24px gap and a 16px label. Raise the key digits to 16px in a 24px chip with 8px inset. Replace the 'wheel' placeholder with a proper header cell.

P1 whole card, hierarchy: Make '$900' the one hero number at 32px/800 with 24px spacing from the other stats. Drop section labels to 16px tx-2 and keep tab text at 20px. Move 'xp' and 'stash 3,750 bag 0' into a muted 16px group.
P1 header stats and top tab row: Move armory and trophies to the header-right as 40px-high bordered buttons. Keep the tab row for filters only. Set every gap in this row to 16 or 24px.

P1 stash grid (left pane): Draw empty slots as faint 1px dashed cells to fill the grid, as the backpack does, or use a larger tile with the item name below at 16px. Move the right pane's loadout/backpack split to match the grid's cell size.

P1 bottom 'freebie kit' bar and legend row: Give 'take' a 48px-high rect with 4px radius and no top tab. Show the kit contents as small icons in the bar. Cut the legend to the 3 needed hints, or show it only on hover.

05-sector-page.verdict: The ascend button is a strong primary action and the card structure is sound, but the dead column, unreadable map labels and tiny, inconsistent type keep it at a 3.
findings: P1 right column, y 530-890 (between the belt and the armour warning): Add a 4-column grid of 72px pack slots (--ui-raised fill, 1px --ui-line border) under the pack header. Otherwise move the belt and the warning up under the data core row with 24px gaps. Put 1px --ui-line dividers between kit, pack and belt. Enlarge the belt cells to 48px.

P1 map labels ('the long dock', 'foreman office', 'blast freezer', 'chill row', 'exit a/b/c'): Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1 with a 1px --ui-void halo. Move labels at least 8px clear of boxes and markers. Set exit labels in --extract at 16px. Remove the purple squares or add a 'keyed' legend entry. Draw room boxes with a --ui-raised fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 conditions column ('blackout +5% sp', 'night' row): Widen the column by 20px, or drop the value to a right-aligned 16px 'sp +5%' so every row stays on one line. Draw selected as a lime check plus a --ui-raised fill, and focus as a single 2px --acc border. Remove the 'conditions' heading. Set the section labels to 16px tx-2 with 16px of space above them.

P1 type sizes across the card (kit sublines, 'no armour equipped', 'burn for intel', 'enter', footer legend): Set the sublines, warning and checkbox label to 16px. Set the 'kit', 'pack' and 'belt' section labels to 16px f-cond 700 tx-2 with a 1px divider above each. Left-align 'no data core' to the icon. Set the warning to 16px --warn.

P2 kit tiles (my loadout, freebie kit, random kit, best kit): Give the selected tile a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill, and use a --ui-line border on the others. Increase the tile height to 64px with an 8px gap.

06-terms.verdict: The earlier advice was mostly followed: the title now sits at the top left, the focused row has a lime bar, and signed is a lime fill. The card still looks half-built, because the list ends at y=648 and about 370px of the card is empty below it.
findings: P1 whole card, y=650-1024: Make the rows 100px tall so the list fills y=200-760. Pin a 72px footer at the bottom of the card with 'sign nothing' on the left and the 'sp x1.10' total on the right. Use a 48px side margin so the column spans x=145-1775 and lines up with the X.

P1 row descriptions, x=287-571, y=262-613: Set them to 16px --tx-2 with a minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Cut each to 4 words or fewer, for example 'machines +40%' and 'raid clock -33%'. Remove the trailing period and the colon.

P1 sign buttons, x=1513-1633: Use a 2px --ui-line-hi border on idle buttons and 18px label text in --tx-1. Replace the double ring on the focused button with a single 3px --acc-hover outline offset 2px.

P1 bonus text '+5% sp', x=1443-1497: Keep the signed bonus in --tx-1 and the idle bonus in --tx-2. Reserve lime for the button fill and the focus bar. Show the +5% once in the header ('each term +5% sp') or only on the active rows.
P2 total 'sp x1.10', x=1604-1659, y=686: Draw it at the 56px hero size in f-cond 800, right-aligned in the footer row, with a 16px --tx-2 label 'score bonus' above it. Remove the hairline at y=711.

07-party-coop.verdict: The party card is now a 90% window as asked, but almost all of it is empty. The content is either pushed to the left edge or floats in the middle of a blank card, and the scrollbar on the input and the explaining sentence are both still there.
findings: P0 whole card, both shots: Go back to a compact fixed card of about 960x400, centred, and write this exception into the style guide for one-question dialogs. If it must stay large, add a real party panel: four 96px slot rows (p1 to p4, empty slots in tx-2) with the host/join actions in a right column.

P0 layout consistency between the two shots: Pin the header row at the top (56px high, title 32px/700 at left padding 32px, x in the same row). Use one left edge of 32px for the title, status and controls. Never vertically centre the content block inside a full-screen card.

P1 invite code field, right edge: Use a single-line input with overflow:hidden and resize:none. Make it 320px wide, 56px high, with a --ui-line-hi border. Give it a 2px --acc border on focus. Set the placeholder to tx-2 at 16px with a 6-char mask format.

P1 title block and body copy, left: Delete the sentence. Keep one 16px tx-1 status line, 'not in a party', with '0/4' right-aligned in the same row. Title 32px/700. Body text must not go below the 16px label floor.

P1 button row: Put host on its own row at the left (240x56, lime). Below it add a 'join with code' group: input 320px + join 160px, with join greyed out until the field has text. Use a 32px gap between the groups. Show a 2px --acc focus ring plus a 4px inset bar on whichever control has pad focus.

08-shop.verdict: The shop is a clean, consistent dark card with one lime action and a clear focus tile, but half the grid area is empty, the detail pane has a big dead gap, and the header and footer details are sloppy.
findings: P1 item grid, rows 3 and up (y 590-1000): Make tiles bigger (about 220x210 with a 72px icon) so 9 items fill about 70% of the height. Or shrink the panel to fit its content. Add category filters in the left column only if they are needed.
P1 detail pane, y 480-770: Add a large item icon (about 160px) under the title and move the price block up. Or put the stats in a 2-column block at 20px and anchor the price block 24px below it.

P1 header, top right (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): Show money as '$900' in the same style as the price. Make stash and bag two matching label-over-value pairs with 32px gaps. Drop xp from the shop if it does nothing here. Leave 24px before the X.
P1 bottom toast 'everything here works. cannot say the same for you.': Delete the line. If a hint line must stay, use 14px f-body tx-2 in the footer row, left-aligned inside the card, with no box.
P2 item tiles, price tags: Set all prices to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1. Use --danger for prices the player cannot afford and drop the lime from prices. Keep lime for the focus border only.

09-craft.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear focus tile and a visible close x, but half the card is empty, the header money readouts are cluttered and contradictory, and the hold-to-craft button and the footer tip are weak.
findings: P1 item grid / left panel: Make tiles fill the panel (for example 4 columns of about 260x200 tiles, or 6 columns with 240px tall tiles), or shrink the panel to fit its content and use the freed height for a larger detail pane with a 96px item preview.

P1 header top-right currency strip: Keep one money readout, '$900', at 20px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Drop the duplicate 'you hold' line. Show stash and bag as 16px tx-2 labels. Leave 24px between the strip and the x. Remove xp from this window.

P1 hold to craft button: When it cannot be done, show a --ui-line-hi 1px outline with tx-2 text at 4.5:1 or better, and add a 16px --danger 'need 3 scrap metal'. When it can be done, use a --acc fill with --acc-ink text, 56px tall, at the 20px size.
P1 bottom tooltip 'half the pillager bots down here walk past scrap. their loss.': Delete it. If a hint is kept, put it in the footer at 14px tx-2, 24px from the card edge, with no box.
P2 tab row and 'you hold' line: Set tabs at 20px f-cond 600 with a 3px --acc underline on the active one, and a 48px row height. Remove the 'you hold' row, which also gives the grid back about 30px.

10-hire.verdict: A tidy dark window with a clear lime focus tile and a consistent X, but a red warning banner, a hire button that cannot be seen, and a 30,000 price repeated on every tile hold it back from polished.
findings: P0 top of the tab content, the '***experimental feature may glitch***' banner: Delete the asterisks. Make it a small 16px --warn amber tag with a glyph at the right end of the tab row, or drop it. Remove the .2em tracking and the 28px size.

P0 right pane, 'hire' button at about y=897: When affordable, fill the button with --acc and use --acc-ink text at 20px/700. When not affordable, keep the outline but show the price in --danger and the label in --tx-2 at 4.5:1. Make the button 56px tall.
P1 detail pane, name 'xx_beefstuffer69_xx' and tag 'pillager bot': Use --tx-1 at 32px/700 for the name. Use the red only on the price when the player cannot afford it. Keep the tag at 16px --tx-2.

P1 detail pane, between the 'buy a friend.' line and the price block (about y=430-780): Show 3 or 4 label/value rows (gun, role, raids together) at 20px with 16px labels. Delete 'buy a friend.'. Or shrink the pane and let the grid take the width.

P1 hire grid, the '30,000' price in every tile's top right: Remove it from the tiles and show it only in the detail pane. If it stays, make it '$30k' at 16px --tx-2. Highlight only a tile that cannot be afforded.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: The two-panel layout now fills the card and lines up with the header, which is better than the stacked boxes. But the gamble panel is a big empty box, no button has a focus state or lime primary, and the bottom 30% of the card is dead space.
findings: P0 the gamble panel (left): Put a hero element in the panel: a 56px 'gamble' or prize-pool number with a crate or slot icon at 190px, matching the offer's icon block. Or shrink both panels to about 440px high and centre them.

P0 both action buttons: Give the focused button a --acc fill, --acc-ink text and a 2px lime outline. Keep the unaffordable one at 40% opacity with the red 'need' line. Draw a focus ring on the default row at page load.
P1 panel bottoms and card (y 730 to 1024): Stretch the panels to the card's inner bottom (about y 990, with 24px padding), or centre the pair vertically. Use the same height for both.
P1 panel headings 'the gamble' and 'limited time offer': Make the panel headings 20px at weight 700 and restore the 3px --acc left tab on the offer panel. Make the hero element the only 56px item.

P1 offer panel layout: Left-align the icon at x 997, or centre all the text. Remove the icon's backing box or fill it with --ui-raised. Set the rarity bar to a 3px strip under the icon, not white blocks.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear selected row, but small low-contrast type, an explaining sentence, a clipped list, and a dead right pane keep it from looking polished.
findings: P1 list rows, detail pane and header: Row name 20px tx-1. Sub-lines ('pays', progress) at least 16px in tx-2 #aaa498. Tab labels 20px. The stash/bag legend 16px minimum. Drop the 'standard' tag from every row, since it is identical on all of them and the detail pane already shows it.

P1 under the tabs ('stuff for you to do.') and the list header ('hard work needs 3 more credits (a hard card is worth 2, an elite 3)'): Delete the tab subtitle. Replace the list header with a short stat such as 'done 0 · credits 0/3', 16px, tx-2.

P1 contract list bottom edge: Snap the list height to a whole number of rows, or fade the bottom 24px. Make the scrollbar 6px in --ui-line-hi. Move the toast 24px above the card edge or into the footer row.
P1 selected row: Use the --ui-raised #1e2225 fill, a 3px solid #e6ff3d left bar, and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the selected name to tx-1 at weight 700.

P1 right detail pane: Stretch the pane to the list height (y=227 to 1002), pin the action button to the bottom, and put the reward '$520' at 56px hero size. The disabled button should show a 1px border and tx-2 text.

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: Two columns, a bigger rack counter and bigger tiles give the racks tab a real structure, but it still has no focus state, a lot of explaining text and an empty bottom half.
findings: P1 build a rack, fold, slot a data core: Show a lime outline or fill on the focused or first available button. Make disabled text at least #aaa498 and show the missing cost in the button itself, for example 'need 12 scrap'.
P1 both explaining paragraphs: Delete the import paragraph or cut it to 'import a run report'. Turn the cost into four small chips (icon, 12/0) at 16px, in --danger when short.

P1 the whole content area, y 600 to 1020: Move the rack grid into the empty lower area or make it a 5x2 grid of 96px tiles with rack names. Vertically centre the content or add a detail pane on the right in --ui-raised.
P2 racks counter and tiles: Use tx-1 for the number, or lime when it is above 0. Draw empty tiles with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and built ones with a 3px lime top bar.
P2 layout, columns: Align the left column to the header margin (x 119), or use a wider 2/3 and 1/3 split. Put 'import a friend' in its own titled panel at 16px label size.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: The card is clean, consistent and on style (x top-right, lime focus row with one lime button), but it is an almost empty window with two stretched rows, and a stray toast sentence plus a tiny header currency strip weaken it.
findings: P1 whole card, y 430-950: Either shrink this window to a content-fit card (about 1400x520, centred) or fill it: a 56px hero (the drink or its effect) or a left detail pane in --ui-raised with a bigger 96px icon. Don't leave 600px of void.

P1 toast 'the welcome pack is in your stash.' at bottom centre (819-1101, 963-1001): Remove it from this window, or cut it to a short callout like 'pack in stash' and show it only as a transient toast above the card with the panel style. No trailing period.
P1 blotter description (392-930, y 372): Shorten each description to 3-5 words at 16px --tx-2 (for example 'loud and fast', 'ego off'). Drop the exclamation mark.

P1 header right currency strip (1472-1742, y 80-100): Show only the wallet ($900) in the header at 20px f-cond 700 tx-1. Drop xp, stash and bag, which have no use in a bar. If they must stay, make every label 16px tx-2 with 24px gaps and put 32px between the strip and the x.

P2 row 1 vs row 2 focus treatment: Focus = lime left bar plus raised fill only. Make the button lime only when the row has focus (as now), with a 2px lime outline on the focused button. Give the idle button a 1.5px --ui-line-hi border and make the label tx-1 at 20px.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: it is a consistent centred card with an x, a tidy tab row and a clear grid, but the eye has no single focal point, there are two items with the same fill and the supporting type is too small and dim for a couch.
findings: P1 tile grid, 'worn' bare and crop tiles: worn: --ui-raised fill, 3px lime left bar and a small lime 'worn' tag. Pad focus: 2px --acc outline plus a 4px glow, never the same fill as worn.

P1 header and left column, no hero: make the operator preview the hero by lighting its backdrop and raising it to ~380px. Set the panel headings to --tx-1 at 20px 600. Reserve lime for the selected tab, the worn tile and focus. Set the title to 32px.

P1 tile sublabels (unlock hints) and category labels 'headgear' and 'hairstyle': raise the hints to 16px --tx-2 (4.5:1 or better). Raise the category labels to 16px with +.04em tracking. Move the hint to a 2-line area under the name, with a darker scrim behind it.

P1 left list (outfit, build, skin, hair...): make the preview shorter (~300px) so all rows fit, or turn the list into a 2-column grid of 48px chips. Rows are 48px with a 20px value and a 16px label. Remove the inner scrollbar.

P2 top-right currency row: show '$900' as the only hero-weight number (--fs-body 700). Make xp and stash 16px --tx-2 with the same number-to-label gap. Put 24px between groups and 32px before the x. Drop 'credits'.

18-settings-hub.verdict: The detail pane no longer has a paragraph pinned to its bottom, but its description is now cut off mid-sentence and the other 3-score faults (a mostly empty pane, a faint focus on the left rail, a 'close' that is only text) are unchanged.
findings: P0 detail pane, description under 'edit the words': Show the full text, or write a short one-line description that ends cleanly, such as 'click any word to rewrite it'. If it must be clipped, use an ellipsis. Place it at 20px f-body in tx-2, directly under the 32px title with a 16px gap.

P1 detail pane, overall: Fill the pane with something useful: the current value as a 56px hero number (the hero token) and the options in a row, and a default marker. Or shrink the pane to fit its content (max-height about 240px) and give the list more width.

P1 left rail (the raid selected): Give the selected tab a 3px full-height lime bar and tx-1 text, and dim the unselected tabs to tx-2. When focus moves to the list, drop the rail's fill and keep only the lime text.
P1 spacing between 'experimental' and 'master volume': Use a 24px gap, put a 16px section label ('audio') above the group, and keep the 1px divider centred in the gap.

P2 setting rows, left label and right value: Narrow the value column to about 240px and align it nearer the labels, or right-align the value with the arrows at 16px from the row edge. Raise the row label to tx-1 for the focused row only.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The raid hud is still a crowded, equal-weight set of boxes: ammo is a clear hero, but the stacked top-right panels, the permanent controls card and the always-on explaining text bury it, and the hud looks the same as before.
findings: P0 top-right: cash/stash card plus run info card: Collapse run info to the contracts only (3 lines at 16px, tx-2) and delete the weather effect sentence. Keep one 24px margin from the screen edge. Show cash as a single hero-weight $ figure and drop the stash, xp and backpack grid.

P0 bottom-centre controls card (wasd / ctrl / lmb ... f1 full list): Show it only for the first 20 s of a raid or on f1, then fade over 240 ms. If it stays, cut it to 6 rows, raise the footer to 16px at tx-2 or brighter, and use one panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 centre callouts ('scav pistol · equip your own gun at the stash.', 'rain · covers your noise and theirs', 'the welcome pack is in your stash.'): Keep one callout slot, 20px f-cond, max 3 words, no punctuation. Remove the duplicate scav pistol hint from the left stack and from the hint strip.

P1 left-edge tag stack ('rain', 'scav pistol') and the bar below the hotbar ('scav pistol fire use'): Merge tags into one 16px stack on a --ui-panel fill at 90% with 8px padding. Fold 'fire use' into the hotbar's selected slot, or drop it.

P1 hp/stamina/standing block, bottom-left: Use one panel style, 4px radius, 24px from the bottom and left edges. Make hp the single hero at 56px f-cond 800 and shrink the stamina bar to 8px tall with a 16px label. Drop the 'standing' label box or make it a plain 16px tx-2 tag.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The new raid hud is effectively the old one with different contract text and a different toast; it is still a cluttered stack of small, low-contrast corner boxes with an always-open key legend and no clear focal point.
findings: P0 Raid HUD overall hierarchy: Close the key legend by default (show it for 10s on raid start, then f1 only). Keep the ammo as the one hero at 56px. Drop the stamina and hp bars to 12px thin bars with a 16px label, and keep the hp number at 32px max.

P0 top-left 'current pillager bots' scoreboard and top-right cash/run info/contracts stack: Use one panel style: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, 20px row names and 16px labels. Give the right column one fixed width (320px), 16px gaps and a 48px margin. Keep scores and contracts at 16px minimum. Put 'no downs yet' under a 'bonus' label in tx-2.

P1 bottom-left toasts ('codex entry · scav pistol · common', 'running slowly'): Make every toast the same: a 3px left bar (warn for hints, tx-2 for info), 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1 on a --ui-panel pill at 90%, 8px gap between toasts. Put the status text at tx-1 (not 50% grey) so it reaches 4.5:1.

P1 center-bottom controls legend: Collapse it into a one-line footer hint ('f1 controls', 14px, tx-2) after the first raid. If it must stay, use two aligned columns on a 480px panel at 16px with 24px row height.

P1 hotbar and weapon tag: Hide empty slots, or draw them as 1px outlines without silhouettes. Use one focus treatment (the lime --acc 2px border on the active slot only). Slot numbers 16px. Make both hints the same chip style.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: The window shell (title left, x top-right, centred card, lime m close key) is consistent and clean. The map is still a crowd of tiny labels and the contracts column is a flat list of identical rows, so the eye has no clear first stop. The 'cache' labels now clump into leader-line tangles at the top-right and right-middle.
findings: P1 map, strongbox/blast freezer cluster (x 920-1080, y 360-560): Merge duplicate-type tags into one label with a count, for example 'cache x4'. Keep one leader line per label. Keep the tag column at least 24px clear of the zone and extract labels. Drop the leader lines when the icon is within 40px.
P1 map, top-right (x 960-1060, y 180-290): Combine them into one 'cache x3' label. Put it outside the room rectangle at least 12px from the 'locked' label. Use 16px type.

P1 contracts panel, rows: Draw the progress bar as a 4px track in --ui-line with a --acc fill proportional to progress. Set reward text in --tx-1 and the name in --tx-1 at 20px. Give every row a count in the same slot ('0/1') so 'open' does not break the column.

P1 map labels, overall: Use three tiers: extract labels 20px --extract, point-of-interest labels 16px --tx-1, zone names 16px --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Give POI labels a 1px dark text outline or a 60% --ui-void chip behind them.
P2 map, left edge (old image only; 'codex entry' toast): None needed. Confirm in a later capture that toasts never draw over the window card.

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The only change is a small x button in the corner, and it sits beside the old 'b or i to close' text. The rest of the card still looks like a debug panel: the slots are bare, the item detail is flat, and the stats are one cramped line.
findings: P1 close x (1345-1383 x 327-363) and 'b or i to close' text (y 367): Delete the 'b or i to close' text. Make the x a 32px button, 16px from the card's top and right edges, with a 'b' key-cap chip beside it. Align its centre with the title baseline at y 362.

P1 selected item block (y 780-880), 'use' / 'armor' row and hint line: Put the block in a --ui-raised pane with 16px padding. Make 'use' a lime --acc button with --acc-ink text and an 'e' key-cap chip. Change 'armor' to 'armour'. Render the hints as key-cap chips (1px --ui-line-hi border, 8px gaps) in a footer row. Cut 'drag to tactical belt'.

P1 slot grid (566-1354 x 548-737): Give each slot a --ui-bg fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and an 8px gap. Add a 3px rarity bar along the bottom of each filled slot. Show '3 / 16' at 16px tx-2 in the section header. Put the item count in a small --ui-void chip.

P1 equipped block (566-1354 x 400-525): Put the weapon in a --ui-raised panel with a 64px icon, 16px padding and a 3px rarity bar. Move the pip clear of the text. Lay the stats out in a 4-column grid with 24px gutters: label 16px tx-2 above value 20px tx-1. Label '12 / 24' as 'ammo'.

P1 card frame (530-1390 x 318-921) and hotbar overlap (y 921-950): Put --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) behind the card. Either grow the card to about 90% of the screen, or lift it so there is at least 24px between its bottom edge and the hotbar tooltip.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: The pause card now has one clear hero (lime resume) and a danger-outlined abandon button that fits the button column, but it is still a stacked list of five similar buttons with a thin, template-like card.
findings: P1 button stack, report a problem / feedback / what's new: Merge report a problem and feedback into one 'feedback' button. Keep settings as the only full-width secondary. Move what's new into a 16px tx-2 text link row, or drop it from pause. Result: resume, settings, one small row, abandon.

P1 abandon run button: Add 32px of space above abandon and a 1px --ui-line divider, or keep it as a quiet danger ghost with no box. Show the confirm step only on press. Make the border --danger at 60% and fill it with a red tint at 10% only when focused.

P1 focus state: Add a 2px --acc outline with a 2px offset (or a 3px left focus bar plus a --ui-raised fill) on the focused row, distinct from the filled primary style. Show this state in the next shot with focus on settings.

P2 title row: Make the X hit area 48x48 and draw it in tx-2 at 2px stroke, brightening to tx-1 on hover and focus. Set 24px between the divider and the first button, so it matches the 24px card padding.

P2 card proportions: Keep it as a narrow dialog but make padding uniform at 40px on all sides. Add the run context (time, map, carried $) as one 16px tx-2 line under the title so the card says something about this run.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: The new settings window is a huge fix (the old one was a broken, empty header stuck at the bottom of a black screen), and it now reads as a real centred card with tabs, rows and focus. But the content is a narrow column with dead side space, the controls float far from their labels, and the bottom of the list and the footer are crowded and cut off.
findings: P1 row controls (chevron, value, chevron): Right-align the stepper group to the row's right padding (16px). Or cap the row at 900px at 1080 so the label-to-control gap is under 400px. Make the chevrons about 24px with a 48px hit area.

P1 list bottom edge / 'how much is out there' row: Size the list to a whole number of 56px rows (at 4K, 112px each) or add a 24px fade mask at the bottom. Widen the scrollbar to 6-8px, with a visible track, and inset it 8px from the panel edge.
P1 window layout / side margins: Keep the 900px-at-1080 measure but align the title, tabs and footer to the same column. Or fill the card with a left category nav and a right detail pane.

P1 detail pane (edit the words): Drop the repeated title and shrink the pane to one 16px tx-2 line. Replace the copy with something neutral like 'changes the in-game wording'. Align the pane's left padding with the row text at x=522.
P2 tab strip: Use 20px tabs with 24px side padding and a 3px underline. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row, or make it a ghost button, and add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

32-keys-window.verdict: A clean, near-full-screen dark card with an x in the corner that matches the window rule, but a flat wall of same-weight rows, tiny section labels, a long gap between each action and its key, and a half-clipped row at the bottom keep it from looking polished.
findings: P1 list bottom edge, rows 'controls list' / 'order your hire': Fade the list out over the last 24px with a gradient mask, or snap the scroll to whole rows and add 16px bottom padding. Make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, brightening on focus.

P1 section headers 'move' / 'fight' / 'world': Set the headers to 16px f-cond 700 in tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the lime bar 3px wide and match its height to the header text, or span the header plus its first row. Keep 24px above each header and 8px below.

P1 row layout, action name vs key cap: Narrow each column to about 760px and give each row a 1px --ui-line bottom divider, or put the key cap directly after a fixed 360px label column. Add a --ui-raised fill for the focused row.
P1 pad focus / selected state: Draw focus as a 2px --acc border on the cap plus a --ui-raised row fill. Show a 'press a key' state with an --acc-ink on --acc cap. Keep the rest quiet.

P2 title bar 'keys' and x: Remove the stray tick or turn it into a 3px by 36px tab drawn on purpose. Make the header row 56px with the title centred vertically. Put the x in a 44px square with a focus border.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: the closer camera makes the player and nearby threats easier to read, but the screen still drowns the one thing that should win, the pillbox alert, under nine simultaneous panels and a triplicated warning.
findings: P0 top-center alert vs left-side event log vs world tag, 1080 shot: drop the floating world tag (keep it on the pillbox icon only, no duplicate text) and let the event log entries fade after ~3s instead of persisting under an active toast; one alert surface, not three.

P0 bottom-center floating keybind panel, overlaps the walkway between player and pillbox: move this to a corner (e.g. bottom-left under hp/stamina) or collapse it to the "f1 full list" toggle only, so the center of the screen is clear during combat; it already has a caret, so default it collapsed after the first few seconds of a raid.

P1 right edge: credits/xp/stash/backpack stack, minimap, run info panel: demote the stat stack to tx-2 (muted) numbers until they change, keep only --acc on the one number that just updated, and tighten panel padding so the column reads as one unit, not three competing boxes.

P1 world tags "pillbox v-64" and "sentry k-98" compared old vs new shot: pin entity name-tag text to a fixed screen size (e.g. --fs-label, 16px) regardless of camera zoom, same as the style guide's other labels, so zoom changes don't silently drift type scale.
P1 whole 1080 frame: during an active alert, auto-dim or shrink the non-combat panels (bots list, keybind card) to ~60% opacity so the eye has fewer equal-weight boxes to parse.

35-kia-card.verdict: The new card is cleaner: the loss figure now leads, the xp line is shorter, and the feedback control reads as a button. The main hero is no longer the red title or the red number, but the card still has too many small grey lines and a soft hierarchy.
findings: P1 title 'killed in action' vs the $1,770 hero: Keep the title at 32px f-cond 700 red. Make $1,770 the single 56px 800 hero, and put it in the danger red it had before, or keep it tx-1 and drop the red from 'items lost'. Pick one place for red emphasis.
P1 header block (subtitle + xp line): Cut it to 'killed by unknown · 152m'. Render the line at 16px tx-2 or better, and move '+65 xp' into the stat row as a fifth cell, or drop the penalty text.

P1 item tiles row: Keep 24px between the loss label and the tiles and 32px between the tiles and the stats rule. Add '+1' as a fifth tile or a count label so 4 tiles match '5 items'. Make the bars 3px and enlarge the x2 badge to 16px text.
P2 'how did that run feel +' button: Use 16px tx-1 label, 1px --ui-line-hi border with 8px/16px padding, drop the '+', and leave 32px above the primary button.
P2 stats row (containers, kills, accuracy, time): Keep the row but drop the bottom rule, set the values at 20px tx-1 and the labels at 16px tx-2, or collapse it to a single muted line.

38-extracted-card.verdict: The ghost feedback button and the tighter spacing are small improvements, but the card now has a 32px title and a second checklist line, so it is still a stack of small centred lines. The $1,770 hero is the only strong element, and the title no longer leads.
findings: P1 title 'extracted' vs haul number: Keep the hero at 56px. Make the title 32px/700 with 8px under it. Fold 'out clean · never spotted' and '+130 xp' into one 16px line in tx-2 so the header is two lines, not three.

P1 checklist lines: 'extract without killing anything' / 'burst carbine': Drop the sentence row or shorten it to 'no kills'. Group the objectives under one 16px label in a 24px block with 8px row gaps. Colour the ✓ var(--ok).

P1 vertical rhythm of the whole card: Use three groups, each with a 32px gap between them: header (title, one line), the haul (label, hero, tiles), and the stats. Keep gaps inside a group at 8px or 16px, and put the checks and badges inside the stats group.

P1 'how did that run feel +' ghost button: Make the ghost 44px tall with 16px/600 text in tx-2, and add a 16px border in --ui-line-hi. Leave 24px between it and the primary. Replace '+' with a chevron, or drop it.

P2 stat strip and tags: 'first out · untouched · ghost': Set the labels to 16px/600 with +.04em tracking. Draw the tags as small bordered chips at 16px with an 8px gap. Dim a stat with 0 to tx-2 and keep non-zero values in tx-1.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: A clean, compact dark card with a lime focus bar, an x and one lime action, but it is small, its content is a plain numbered list, and the busy hub behind it competes with it.
findings: P1 card size and placement: Decide whether this is a window or a toast. If it is a window, make it about 90 percent wide. If it stays small, raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and hide the hotbar and hint toast while it is open.
P1 hierarchy: Make the items f-cond 600 at 20px in tx-1 with a lime or tx-2 number column. Keep the title at 32px/700. Make the version tx-2 or a small tag. Keep the lime fill on the button only.
P1 footer row: Delete the hint line. Keep x and 'got it'. If a key hint stays, show it as an enter glyph inside the button. Show the live pad button on pad.
P2 x close button: Use a 40px button, a 20px glyph in tx-1 and 16px from the top and right edges. Run the divider the full card width so the left and right padding match.
P2 spacing and alignment: Use 16px row gaps with 1px --ui-line dividers, 24px between header and list, 24px between list and footer, and a 3px bar.

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case, but it is unchanged from the last review: the empty body is centered, the prompt is a dim ring-and-text with no real focus state, and the small card is neither a proper dialog nor a window.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206 x 605-628): Make it a 56px-high primary button with fill #e6ff3d, text #11150a at 20px/700, min-width 200px, right-aligned 24px from the card edge. Or use tx-1 text with a 3px #e6ff3d underline and drop the ring.

P1 card body, 'no scores yet' (x≈906-1014, y≈534): Left-align it at x=714 in tx-2, 20px/400, 24px below the header. Add 3 dim placeholder rows at a 56px pitch ('1 ---', '2 ---', '3 ---') with 1px #2e3337 dividers.

P1 card structure (682-1238 x 412-667): Choose one. For a dialog, make it 480x240 with 24px padding. For a window, make it 90% wide and tall with a 56px header and a 72px footer holding the primary on the right.
P2 close X, top-right of card (1167-1215 x 430-476): Use a 1px #4a5257 border, a 20px close glyph in tx-2, and a 'B' glyph 8px to its left. Inset it 24px from the top and right edges.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (96-210 x 60-88): Set it in tx-2 at 70% opacity, or remove it. If kept, use 32px with a 36px lime tab above it, aligned to x=96.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: The raid hud is cleaner than a typical amateur one, with a clear hero ammo number and an all-lower-case hotbar. But the corner widgets use different panel styles, the type sizes are scattered, and the hp, armour and stamina bars are all the same weight, so the screen still reads as parts from several different screens.
findings: P1 top-centre score/timer plate: Use one panel: a 16px top margin, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Make the timer the 56px f-cond 800 hero and drop the score to 20px tx-2. Put the extract chip inside the panel on its own 16px row, and move the arrow into that row.

P1 bottom-left hp/armour/stamina bars: Hp is the one hero bar: 28px tall, 20px label. Armour and stamina are 10px slim bars, tx-2 labels at 16px, set outside the fill. Keep a 5% margin (96px left, 48px bottom). Put a 1px --ui-void backing under each bar so they hold up on any floor colour.

P1 right column: minimap, run info, ammo: Use one panel recipe on all three: --ui-panel 90% fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 24px padding, 16px gap, and one shared width of 320px aligned to the same right margin. Drop the 'run info' heading. Set the goals as 16px rows with 8px gaps, tx-1 for the goal name and tx-2 for progress and reward.

P1 left status chips: f1 controls, fog, stronghold, golden enemy: Use one chip style: 16px f-cond 600, 32px tall, --ui-panel fill, 1px border, 8px gap. Remove the info icons. Fold 'standing' into the same chip. Group the chips in one left-aligned stack with a 48px margin.

P2 hotbar and weapon hint strip: Give the active slot one lime 2px border with --ui-raised fill and no other highlight. Use rarity only as a 3px bottom bar. Set slot numbers to 16px tx-2. Dim empty icons to 40% opacity. Put the weapon name and the hints on one flat strip at 16px.

52-arcade-run-over.verdict: A clean, lower-case, on-token card with a clear hero score, but it is small and left-heavy in a wide empty panel, the title is weak, and the prompt is a tiny afterthought.
findings: P1 card title 'run over': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1 and give it 8px more space below. Keep the hero at 56px, but make it the one bold element.
P1 score hero '0 sp': Raise the hero to 56px, label to 16px. Either centre the hero block or put the score on the left and the three stats stacked on the right so the card fills.
P1 'press any key' prompt: Use a 24px prompt with a pulsing lime key-cap or pad-button glyph, centred or left-aligned under the stats, with 32px of padding above it.
P2 stat row (kills, extractions, deaths): Use 16px labels and 32px numbers on an equal 3-column grid with the same inner padding as the panel. Consider hiding the row when every value is 0.
P2 'ended early -50%' line: Move it next to the score as a 16px label in --warn, or put it on its own row below the hero. Do not stack three small lines between title and hero.

57-title-2p-coop-picked.verdict: The title screen has a clean centred column and a clear focus bar, but the error banner steals the hierarchy, the buttons are thin and generic, and the menu leaves a lot of dead space.
findings: P1 error banner between menu and saves: Shorten the message to 'popup blocked' with a 16px warn-amber glyph. Make retry a normal outlined button, or use the accent fill only while the banner is the sole action. Move the banner to a toast at the top or bottom so the column does not jump.

P1 menu rows (1 player ... 1 player arcade demo): Make 1 player the lead row, 64px tall, with a --ui-raised fill. Group the two arcade demos beneath it as quieter rows. Give the focused row a full lime 2px border plus a --ui-raised fill and a 4px left bar.

P1 title wordmark: Use a flat --tx-1 or lime wordmark at 72px with no gradient or shadow, or make a deliberate logo treatment. Raise the tagline to 16px in --tx-2, with a clear 24px gap above and below it.

P1 saves section and name row: Keep the lime border only on the focused element. Make the idle selected save a 2px --ui-line-hi border with a lime check glyph. Set the controls row to 40px tall with 16px labels. Add 32px of space above the 'saves' label. Raise the label to 16px --tx-2.
P2 background art: Add a 90% --ui-panel card behind the column with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, or darken the scrim to .80 across the middle 640px.

59-raid-abandon-confirm.verdict: The abandon dialog is clean, with a clear hierarchy (title, lime keep playing, red ghost abandon) and one close x. The new version moves the x so it lines up with the title, but the card is still small and sparse, and its edge pieces are off-grid and slightly faint.
findings: P1 Modal card overall (720-1200 x 380-700): Widen to about 560px. Raise the title to a clear 32px with 700 weight, keep the button text at 20px, and make both buttons 64px tall. Add a 3px danger-red top tab or a short danger glyph so the card says 'this costs you' and not just 'confirm'.

P1 Sub-label 'free this early' on the abandon button: Set it at 16px in --tx-2 #aaa498 (4.5:1 minimum) or tx-1. Make the copy concrete, e.g. 'lose your bag, keep $0 risked'. Keep it lower case and to one short line.

P2 Focus and pad indication: Draw a 2px --acc outer ring with a 4px gap on the focused button, whichever it is. Make the danger outline 2px. Add a small 16px pad/key glyph for the confirm and back buttons in the footer (14px legend).
P2 Close x (1124-1148, y 432-456): Put the x in a 40x40 hit box with 16px padding from the corner (top 16px, right 16px). Use a 2px stroke in tx-1, and add a --ui-raised fill on hover or focus.
P2 Top-left lime tab (720-756, 380): Remove the lime tab on this card, or recolour it --danger when the dialog is about loss, so the accent appears only on the primary button.

65-codex.verdict: The tiles now fill the card and the empty void is gone, but the grid is still a narrow column of tiny gun icons in oversized boxes, and a toast sits on top of the bottom row.
findings: P0 bottom centre toast 'trophy earned · motherlode': Move toasts to a fixed zone above the card or at the top (y≈24, outside the card), or end the grid at y≤940 and reserve a 56px footer row for toasts. Never draw it over content.

P1 tile content and icon size: Scale the icon to about 140px, centred in the tile's upper half or filling the left 45%, with the name and tags beside or below it. Use a rarity glow behind found guns. Silhouettes on locked tiles need about 25% more brightness.

P1 vertical alignment inside tiles: Anchor the name baseline at a fixed offset (tile top + 32px). Reserve the kills row for every found gun, or show a muted 'kills 0'. Give the new badge 8px inset and 16px type.

P1 grid layout in the card: Run the grid from the card padding (x=119 to x=1801), with 24px gutters (8px grid), which gives about 410px tiles. Or add a left filter rail (rarity, class) so the width is used.
P1 locked tiles 'not found': Show only the rarity bar and a class name on locked tiles, drop the 'not found' repetition, and lift the rarity text to full --r-* colours at 16px minimum.

66-trophy-case.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear x and a readable grid, but the tiles are big and empty, the title is small, and unlocked and locked states barely differ in hierarchy.
findings: P1 header title 'trophy case · 6 of 8': Make the title 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Move '6 of 8' to the right of the header, next to the x, in tx-2 at 20px, or make it the one 56px hero count. Pad the header to 24px.

P1 all 8 tiles: Cut the tile height to about 260px and use a 4x2 grid with a 24px gap. Scale the icon to about 96px. Alternatively use 6 columns of smaller tiles so the card is not mostly void. Fill earned tiles with --ui-raised and keep locked tiles on --ui-panel.

P1 locked tiles (full armory, overseer down): Draw locked icons as a 2px outline in --ui-line-hi (#4a5257), not a dark fill. Keep the locked name and description at tx-2 or brighter (4.5:1 minimum). Replace the 'locked' tag with a 16px tx-2 label.
P1 trophy tier colours: Make all earned icons one neutral tone (tx-1 at 70%). Put a 3px top bar in the tier colour on each tile, as the rarity bars do elsewhere. Use lime only for focus.

P2 tile text sizes: Set the name to 20px tx-1 (600), the description to 16px tx-2 and the date to 16px tx-2 at 60% opacity. Add 8px of spacing between them, and put the date at the bottom edge of the tile.

62-arcade-operator-menu.verdict: The new version is slightly cleaner: the doubled outer ring on the focused row is gone and the close button is smaller. It is still a tiny generic dark card floating in an empty black screen, with no identity and a weak focus read.
findings: P1 whole screen / backdrop: Show the attract frame or live world at about 55% brightness under rgba(6,7,8,.80). Add a faint marquee or scanline motif at 6-8% opacity behind the card.

P1 card size and hierarchy: Either scale the card to the window standard, or keep it as a compact dialog. Then add a 16px tx-2 state line under the title (for example party size) and raise the row text to 24px with 56px row height. Make the title 32px f-cond 800.

P1 new party row (focus state): Add a right-aligned 'enter' key cap, 24px from the edge, in --acc-ink on a 1px acc-ink-at-40% border. Keep the label at 20px f-cond 700 with 24px left padding. Add a 2px tx-1 outline at a 2px offset only for pad focus.
P2 exit demo row: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 text. Add a right-aligned 'esc' key cap and optionally a --danger tint (text and 1px border at 60%).
P2 footer key legend: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Use 8px inside a group and 24px between groups. Keep a single esc/back entry and drop either the X or the legend.

61-raid-wheel-open.verdict: The wheel is the right hero with a strong lime focus wedge, but the HUD around it is still small, mixed-size and cluttered, and the only change from before is slightly different contract text in the run info panel.
findings: P1 wheel item labels and pip boxes: Put the icon in the upper 60% of each wedge and the label in a fixed row below it with a 16px gap. Make the label 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 (tx-2 for empty slots, at least 4.5:1). Move the pips to the wedge's outer arc, not behind the label.

P1 top-right career and run info panels: Set all text in these panels to at least 16px. Remove the carets. Use one panel style (--ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 24px padding) with the same padding and row height. Cut the 'running slowly' repeat: it shows twice, once top-centre and once bottom-left.

P1 wheel centre and 'q release to take out' prompt: Make the key cap tx-1 on --ui-raised with a 1px line-hi border, not a lime fill, and anchor the prompt directly under the wheel centre. Change the 'cook and throw' sub-label to tx-2 at 16px and keep lime for the wedge outline only.

P1 bottom-left status stack: Stack them in one 24px-wide-grid block, same 20px bar height, 8px gap and 16px label. Keep the hp number as the single hero at 32px and shrink the stamina label to 16px. Make the 'standing' tag a plain 16px tx-2 label with no box.

P2 hotbar and ammo block bottom: Use a single slot style: --ui-panel fill, 1px line-hi border, with lime outline only on the selected slot. Raise slot digits and the key hint strip to 16px. Drop the duplicate weapon name from the strip. Make the footer text 16px in tx-2.

58-coop-player2-window-title.verdict: the clutter is gone and the lime button now leads the screen, but the amber gradient title competes with it, the lower block is cramped and the type is off-scale.
findings: P1 title 'pillagers' (about 56px, amber gradient with drop shadow): Fill it flat --tx-1 #efe9dc with no gradient and no shadow, f-cond 800 at 56px. Leave lime to the button and the focused save row.

P1 button, 'player 2 window' label and saves block (y 511–735): Use an 8px grid: 24px between title block and button, 32px from button to saves. Move 'player 2 window' into a 16px tx-2 chip above the title or into the top-left, not under the button. Give the saves label a 16px tx-2 size with 8px below it.

P1 name row: 'pillager' input, 'change name', 'create a new save': Make the row 48px high with 16px labels at weight 600. Make the input a --ui-raised field with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a visible focus ring in lime. Fold the two actions into one 'new save' ghost button, or keep 'change name' only on the selected row.

P1 type scale across the page (tagline, 'saves', row values, hints, 'v0.0737'): Snap to 56/32/20/16/14. Make the tagline 20px --tx-2 #aaa498 with a --scrim panel or stronger vignette behind it. Make the row stats 16px tx-2. Keep the version at 14px, only in the footer.

P1 background art behind the menu column: Raise the --scrim to .80 across the centre, or put the menu column on a 560px-wide --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep the art visible at the edges only.

46-arcade-attract-how-to-play.verdict: the how-to-play card is tidy and fully lower case, but the previous fixes were mostly not applied: the prompt is still white with a radio dot, the card is still narrow with small text, and the scrim is still too light, so it reads as a tidy table rather than something polished.
findings: P1 footer prompt 'press any key' (x≈1166-1346, y≈838-870): Set the text to 20-24px f-cond 700 in --acc #e6ff3d, swap the radio dot for a 16px key glyph, and use a 72px footer row under the 1px --ui-line rule. Keep the right edge at x=1346.

P1 card scale (x 541-1378, y 176-905): Widen the card to about 1600-1700px (90%), set row names to 24px and keycaps to 22px, and use 64px rows. If you keep it narrow, scale the text to 20px minimum and pad every side by 24px.

P1 column headers 'keyboard' / 'controller' (x≈759, 1053; y≈271-285): Set them to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 #aaa498 or brighter, inside a 40px header row above the existing 1px rule.
P1 close X (x≈1298-1346, y≈192-239): Delete it on this walk-up screen. If you keep it, make it a 48x48 ghost button with a 24px glyph in a 56px header row.
P2 background scrim (whole screen): Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and lift the card border to --ui-line-hi #4a5257.

37-raid-extracting-countdown.verdict: The new frame only quietens the ammo panel and swaps some copy. The extraction countdown is still a flat teal banner with several other competing panels, and the hero number is now the faintest thing in the corner.
findings: P0 bottom-right ammo panel: Restore the panel to 90% opacity of --ui-panel (#16191b). Keep 12 / 24 in tx-1 at 56px. Put the weapon name and the backpack line in tx-2 at a minimum of 16px, at least 4.5:1.

P1 center-bottom 'extract b inbound 15s' banner: Make the seconds the hero: 56px f-cond 800 in --extract, with 'extract b inbound' at 20px tx-2 beside it. Shrink the slab to hug the text. Leave 16px of space above the hostiles strip, and fold the strip into the same card as a danger-red label.

P1 left-middle pickup/status stack: Use one pill component: 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 3px left bar coloured for the type only. Make rows 32px high with 8px gaps. Move 'running slowly' next to the 'standing' state tag at bottom-left.
P1 top-right contracts panel: Leave the corner for the cw-trcol column. For the contracts, use 16px tx-2 labels, a lime tick only on a finished row, and one shared 16px inner padding for both cards.

P2 top-left 'current pillager bots 3' scoreboard: Highlight the 'you' row with a 3px lime left bar and tx-1 text, and make the other rows tx-2. Use 24px of panel padding and the same header style as run info.

77-haul-reveal-done.verdict: solid materials (real icons, correct color tokens, correct $ and lowercase rules) but four competing bold elements and nine stacked center-aligned blocks leave no single focal point and read as a generic dense modal rather than a confident extraction reveal.
findings: P0 whole card: 'extracted' title, haul '$7,620', the two bold 'recovered to the armoury' lines, and the lime CTA text: drop to one hero: keep --fs-hero 56px bold only on the $7,620 haul number, set 'extracted' to --fs-title 32px at tx-1 weight 700 (not full teal fill-bold), and set the two recovery lines to --fs-body 20px tx-2 regular, not bold

P1 the two checkmark lines, 'extract with a haul worth $1,600 or more' / 'extract without using a single heal': left-align inside a bordered row, cut to a condensed label ('haul $1,600+', 'no heals used') at --fs-label 16px next to the check glyph, remove 'extract' repeated in both

P1 item grid, rows of icons ending in '+7 more' (img1) / '+11 more' (img2): either show a full scrollable grid inside a bordered sub-panel (match the ARC Raiders CONTAINER/BACKPACK panel pattern with its own header) or drop to a single row of the 4-5 highest value items plus a 'view all' as a real control, not trailing grey text

P1 entire card body (title block, xp, 2 challenges, 2 recovery lines, item grid, haul, stat row, tag row, feedback prompt, button): wrap 'containers/kills/accuracy/time' in one --ui-raised panel and the challenge checks in another, each with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --sp-2 padding, so the eye reads 3-4 panels instead of 9 loose text rows

P2 every line in the card: title, subtitle, challenges, stat labels, tag row: keep the card centered on screen but left-align the text content inside each panel/row, per the --f-cond 'scan' intent in the type tokens

63-arcade-operator-new-party-armed.verdict: The armed row now reads tx-1 on dark red with a thin lime focus edge and the close button is smaller, but the card still floats on a flat black void with a tiny helper line, so it is a cleaner template modal rather than a polished one.
findings: P1 Backdrop: Render the live world behind it dimmed to about 55% under --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80). Keep the card at a deliberate size, or bring it toward the 90% window spec.

P1 Confirm new party row: Use a #1e2225 fill with a 1px --danger border and a 3px --acc left bar inset by 0. Keep red to the border and a small 'clears best' label. Make the row 56px tall with a 16px gap to the next row.
P1 Helper line 'clears tonight's best · new seed': Fold it into the armed row as a right-aligned 16px tx-2 value ('clears best, new seed'), or delete it. If kept, use 16px at 4.5:1 or better.
P2 Exit demo row: Make exit demo a ghost row with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-2 text. Put the dangerous confirm on the row the player has to reach deliberately.
P2 Close button: Align the x right edge to the row edge at x=1246, make it 48px, and centre it on the title's cap height.

55-arcade-run-over-scored.verdict: A clean, calm dark card with a clear hero score and one lime focus, but the type is too small for couch reading at 1080, the card is small and left-weighted on a big empty panel, and the initials entry competes with the score.
findings: P1 labels: score, kills, extractions, deaths, tonight's best, hint line: Raise every label to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Keep 14px only for the footer legend. Give the hint line 16px as well.
P1 initials block: Make the letters 40px with 24px gaps and a 3px underline under each slot, lime only on the active slot. Cut the hint to 'enter done' at 16px, or show only the pad glyphs.

P1 hero score area: Set the hero to 56px f-cond 800. Keep the -50% in --warn, but bump it to 20px and put it directly beside or under the number. Use the right half of the row for a rank or best-of-night chip, or tighten the card width.
P2 stats row (12 kills / 0 extractions / 0 deaths): Use 32px numbers in --tx-1 with 16px labels, aligned on a 3-column grid that fills the 24px padding. Dim zero values to --tx-2.
P2 press any key prompt: Set it to 24px with a 32px key/pad glyph. Keep it right-aligned. Optionally pulse the ring at 1.2s to show it is live.

60-abandoned-card.verdict: The new card is tidier: the xp line is shorter, the feedback link is now a visible ghost button, and the red loss number is clearly the hero. The title is still small and the secondary text is still dim.
findings: P1 title 'abandoned': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Keep $1,170 at 56px, and put 24px between the title and the xp line.
P1 xp line '+33 xp · 75% penalty': Use 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498 or brighter). Word it as '+33 xp (75% less)', or colour '75% penalty' with --warn.
P1 stat tile labels and 'left behind': Use 16px labels in tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Use 24px values at weight 700 in tx-1. Put 16px of padding above and below the rules.

P2 'how did that run feel +' ghost button: Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border, tx-1 text at 16px, and 48px height. Keep a 24px gap to the primary button, up from the current 30px between the tiles and the ghost button.
P2 vertical rhythm: Put everything on the 8px grid: 24px between blocks and 32px of padding at the top and bottom. Cut the 80px gap to 32px.

42-hub-pause-box.verdict: A clean, consistent column menu with a clear lime primary and a danger ghost, but it is small and generic, the buttons are crowded and look alike, and the toast and dim backdrop weaken it.
findings: P1 hub pause box, card size: Either treat the pause box as an allowed small dialog and say so in the guide, or scale it up: width 560-640px, button height 64px, label 20px, title 32px. Add one identity element, such as a pillagers wordmark or a run-state line (stash value in `$`) in tx-2 at 16px.

P1 button stack: Merge 'report a problem' into 'feedback'. Move 'what's new' and 'feedback' into a 14-16px tx-2 text-link footer row with a 1px --ui-line divider above it. Keep 'settings' and 'leaderboard' as the only ghost buttons. Add a 24px gap before the danger button.

P1 background and toast: Raise the scrim to --scrim .80 plus a 6px blur on the hub, as the guide says. Hold the toast until the pause closes, or give it the panel style: fill --ui-panel, 16px text, and position it above the card at y=220 with a 3px accent tab.

P2 primary and danger buttons: Shorten them to 'resume' (or 'back to the undercroft') and 'character select'. Lighten the red text to #ff6a4f, or fill the danger button at 12% red with a 1px --danger border.
P2 header: Set the title to 32px 700 tx-1, make the X 20px in tx-2 with a 40px hit area, and make the tab 3px high by 36px wide in --acc so it is visible.

49-arcade-pause-box.verdict: A clean, calm column menu with one lime primary and a red danger ghost. The hierarchy is correct, but the type is small for a couch, the card is small next to the 90% window rule, and the dim backdrop still shows through.
findings: P1 button labels (resume, settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new, end run): Set button labels to 20px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking. Make the title 32px at weight 700 and 36px if there is room.
P1 card size and placement: Either widen to 560 and add 24px more padding, or document the pause box as a small modal in the guide. Keep the X in the corner at 24px inset with a 48px hit target.
P1 backdrop: Use the standard --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) plus a 6px blur on the HUD layer, or hide the HUD layer under the pause card. Do not use the flat ~92% black.
P2 button grid: Merge 'report a problem' and 'feedback' into one 'feedback' button. Put 'what's new' in settings or the footer legend. Leave resume, settings and end run.
P2 end run button: Raise to 20px text and a 2px border, or fill it with 12% danger on focus. Add 16px extra margin above it (48px total) to separate it from the safe actions.

56-arcade-attract-board-scored.verdict: The card is now tidy, with a clear title, a divider and a footer row holding the 'press any key' chip, but it is a small, sparse box with an unnecessary X floating over a busy blurred scene.
findings: P1 Card shell, 558x255 at (681,412): Enlarge to about 640x320 and use a 56px hero '0 sp' (f-cond 800, tx-1) or a 3-row placeholder list inside the body. Keep the 24px padding and the divider.
P1 'no scores yet' at (713,534): Set it to f-cond 600 20px in tx-2 #aaa498. Put a 56px muted '0 sp' above it, or centre the pair vertically in the body between y=490 and y=560.

P1 'press any key' prompt (1027-1206, 600-634): Draw a 32px rounded key chip with a 1px #4a5257 border and the actual key or pad glyph inside. Set the label to 24px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Make the footer row 56px with equal 24px padding top and bottom.
P2 Close X, (1159-1207, 429-477): Remove it. If kept, make it a 40px ghost X with no fill, a tx-2 glyph, a 1px #2e3337 border, and the right edge at x=1214 (24px padding), centred on the title line.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, (95,72): Replace it with a real logo lockup of about 160x48 at (96,54), or remove it so the screen has only the card as its focal point.

47-arcade-drop-controls-card.verdict: The HUD is unchanged from the last review: the vitals, run info panel, ammo block and top-centre score card still each use their own styling, and the screen is cluttered with stacked toasts and tags.
findings: P1 Bottom-left vitals (24-430, 905-1068): Make all three bars 12px high with 8px gaps and a 16px f-cond label inside the left edge. Use --ok for hp, tx-2 for stamina and one cool blue for armour. Turn 'standing' into a 16px tx-2 tag 8px above the stack with no box.

P1 Top-right run info panel (1603-1902, 64-210): Use panel P: #16191b at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, and inset it 48px from the edge. Set the title at 20px 700 tx-1 and 'run goals' at 16px tx-2. Use a 32px row pitch with rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Make the chevron 24px and leave 16px below the panel before any world label.

P1 Top-centre score card, extract line and toasts (880-1160, 0-262): Offset the card 24px from the top. Make 9:58 the 56px hero with 'sp' as a 20px tx-2 line. Put the extract line inside the card as a 16px teal row. Move the arrow to a screen-edge indicator. Put toasts 72px below in one pill style (4px radius, 3px left bar, 16px text, 90% opaque panel) and show only one at a time.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel (1577-1910, 868-1022): Use the shared panel P with a 4px radius and 16px padding. Set the weapon name at 20px tx-2, '60' at 56px 800 tx-1 and '/ 360' at 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Inset 48px from the corner so it lines up with the vitals and run info panel.

P1 Weapon hotbar and prompt (553-1555, 918-1062): Use 56px slots with 8px gaps, tx-2 numerals at 16px minimum, and a lime border on the selected slot only. Dim empty slots to 50% with no icon. Put the prompt 16px above the bar with one key-cap style shared with 'f1'.

48-arcade-hud-move-to-start.verdict: The how-to-play panel and the old B / I backpack clutter are gone, which is a real cleanup, but the HUD is otherwise unchanged: the status stack, score block, run goals and ammo panel are still small, uneven and generic, and the move-to-start prompt is still only a tiny 'shield' tag under the player.
findings: P0 Player 'shield' tag (960,600) and hotbar prompt strip (burst carbine / fire / use): Add one centred prompt at about y=62% in 32px f-cond 700 tx-1, e.g. 'move to start', with a 56px-high key cap for wasd (or the pad stick) on a --ui-panel 90% chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Drop the 'shield' label to 16px tx-2 or remove it. Fold fire/use into the hotbar footer legend at 14px.

P1 Bottom-left stack: 'standing' chip, armour 60, stamina, hp 100 (24-1050): One bar component: 320px wide, 16px high, 8px gap, 16px tx-1 label above each bar in f-cond 600. HP is the only exception: bar 24px high, with a 32px number. Make 'standing' a 16px chip aligned to the same left edge. Inset the stack 48px from the left and bottom, and keep world labels out of the HUD zone.

P1 Top-centre score block (880-1040, 0-135): One 280x112 --ui-panel 90% card, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 24px from the top. Inside: sp number at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, timer at 20px tx-1 beside it or below, and the extract line at 16px --extract inside the same card, with the arrow 8px to the right. Remove the 'score' label or set it to 16px tx-2.

P1 Ammo panel (1578-1910, 870-1020): Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom. Hero '24' at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, reserve '/ 144' at 20px tx-2 on the same baseline. Weapon name 20px tx-2 left-aligned, with the weapon icon at 100% opacity beside it. Use the lime tick only to mark the selected slot, or remove it.

P1 Run info / run goals panel (1603-1900, 65-210): Make it one card: 16px tx-2 label 'run goals', rows at 16px tx-1 with a 32px pitch, and sp values right-aligned in --acc-free tx-2 in a tabular column. 16px padding, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --ui-panel 90% fill, 48px from the right edge and 24px from the top to share the score block's top line. Drop the 'run info' header, since the chevron already says it folds.

53-arcade-extracted-bonus-initials.verdict: A clean, calm dark card with a clear score hero, but the initials entry and the primary prompt compete, and small text is too small and too sparse for a couch.
findings: P1 initials row (a a a) and 'press any key' prompt: Make the active initial lime (--acc) with a 3px lime underline, idle initials tx-1 with a --ui-line-hi underline. Raise the initials to 56px f-cond 800, with 24px gaps. Replace the prompt with a single 'enter done' prompt, or drop 'press any key' while initials are being typed.
P1 hint line 'type or ▲▼ · space next · backspace back · enter done': Cut it to 'enter done' only, at 16px and tx-2. Show a pad glyph when a pad is in use. Move the divider to 24px below the hint.

P1 label sizes: 'score', 'kills', 'extractions', 'deaths', "tonight's best · enter initials", 'extracted x2': Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking, in tx-2 (#aaa498). Use a uniform 8px gap between label and value. Show 'extracted x2' as a 20px tx-1 chip or tag, not as a grey sub-title.
P2 card title 'run over': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Tint the tab and the 'extracted x2' tag with --extract teal on a success, or --danger on a death. Keep the lime for focus only.

P2 stats row (9 kills / 1 extractions / 0 deaths): Use 32px numbers in three equal columns, with 0 shown in tx-2. Or put the hero score and the stats side by side to use the width. Align columns to the 24px padding grid.

54-arcade-initials-redrop.verdict: The card is clean and lower case, with a clear hero score, but the type is small for a couch, the initials entry is weak, and it has the generic card-on-blurred-scene look.
findings: P1 initials row (d b a): Draw three 56px slots, each 64x72 with a 2px --ui-line-hi border. Give the active slot a 2px --acc border and --acc text, and give the others tx-1. Replace the amber with lime. Cut the hint to 'type or ▲▼ · enter done'.
P1 stat labels, 'score' label, hint line, 'tonight's best' label: Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 at +.04em, with colour at least #aaa498. Raise the hint to 16px. Set the stat numbers to 32px.
P1 hierarchy, title versus hero: Set the title to 32px/700. Set the hero to 56px/800. Put the initials directly under the hero as the second tier, and shrink the stats to quiet 20px numbers.

P2 'press any key' button: Enlarge the ring to 40px and the text to 24px/700 in tx-1. Keep it at the bottom right. Make clear that any key continues after the initials are entered, for example by dimming it until the initials are set.

P2 card layout and padding: Use 24px padding and 24px rhythm between blocks. Widen the stats row to a 3-column grid with equal gutters, or centre the score and initials. Make the accent tab 36px by 3px.

64-arcade-board-seeded-night.verdict: The card is clean, lower case and consistent with the guide, but it is small and empty for an empty-state screen, and its text is too small to read from a couch.
findings: P1 subtitle 'seeded night · xj1s': Raise it to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498 or brighter), or drop the seed code and keep only 'seeded night'.

P1 card overall (about 557x280 at screen centre): Make the card at least 640px wide and enlarge the empty state. Put 'no scores yet' at 32px with tx-1, or use a hero-size placeholder. Add a muted outline of an empty rank list, with rows 1 to 5 as dashes, so the screen reads as a scoreboard.
P1 backdrop: Set the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and add a 6 to 8px blur so the lobby recedes.
P2 'press any key' prompt: Make the text tx-1 at 24px, with lime reserved for the ring. Centre the prompt or align it to the left content edge at x=713, and cut the footer height by about 16px.

P2 title row and close button: Centre the title on the X button's midline. Enlarge the X glyph to 20px. Align the lime tab flush to the card's top border and the left padding edge at x=713 with a 2px height.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The detail pane is now flat, but the settings card still has the same weaknesses as before: a narrow 960px column floating in a 1870px card, steppers stranded mid-row, tiny low-contrast tabs, and a list that is clipped mid-row.
findings: P1 whole card: 960px column centred in a 1870px card, with about 450px of empty void on each side: Widen the list column to about 1400px, or add a 280px left rail for the tabs (the raid, audio, controls...) and give the rows the rest. Left-align the title with the column.

P1 value column: arrows at x≈923 and x≈1175, values at x≈1049: Right-align the stepper to a column ending 24px inside the row. Use 20px tx-1 values and 24px tx-2 arrows, with the arrows turning lime only on the focused row. Give action rows ('change keys') a 1px --ui-line-hi pill or button outline so they read as buttons.

P1 tab strip (the raid ... accessibility) and 'send play data' at the top right: Use 20px tabs with 32px gaps, a 3px lime underline plus tx-1 on the active tab, and tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for the rest. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row or into the footer. Add lb/rb glyphs at the strip ends.

P2 bottom of the list, 'stick deadzone' row (y≈825): Snap the viewport to whole rows (for example 10 × 56px = 560px), or add a 24px gradient mask at the bottom. Make the scrollbar 6px in --ui-line-hi and brighter on focus.

P2 detail pane (keys / rebind...), y≈860-978: Put a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill back at 24px padding, with an 8px gap above the pane. Use a 20px tx-1 title and a 16px tx-2 body trimmed to one short clause, e.g. 'rebind any action; conflicts swap'.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: The haul figure now leads, with the chips under it and a cleaner header, but the card is still a stack of small grey lines around a lime button and the haul number is not a clear hero.
findings: P1 haul number and card hierarchy: Raise the haul to 56px at weight 800. Add 24px of space above it and 32px below. Make 'haul' the 16px tx-2 label directly above it. Make the title tx-1 or keep it teal but drop it to 32px so the number is the first read.

P1 checklist block (three check lines): Tighten the row pitch to 32px. Show the objectives as short chips: 'haul $800+', 'data core'. Put the recovered guns as two chips with a gun glyph, and drop the sentence 'extract with a haul worth...'.
P1 header lines under the title: Merge them into one 16px line, 'out clean · +297 xp', and drop 'never spotted' (it repeats the 'ghost' tag). That frees about 24px.

P2 item chip row: Show a single dashed slot, or none, instead of four. Make the chips 72px. Give the focused chip a 2px --acc outline. Put 32px between the haul number and the row, and align '+11 more' to the row's baseline.
P2 stats row (containers / kills / accuracy / time): Drop the numbers to 20px or fold the stats into the footer line. Raise the label colour to tx-2 at 4.5:1. Remove the lower hairline.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: the waiting chip now reads cleanly as the one lime thing (image 2 calms the banner to a raised fill with a thin lime tab), but the screen is still a flat wall of same-weight 16px text with a left-heavy offset layout, a faded half-row at the bottom, and a footer that strands 'esc close' in the corner.
findings: P1 banner 'press a button for sprint · esc cancels': keep the image 2 treatment (--ui-raised fill) with a 3px --acc tab, set text to 20px tx-1, and cut it to 'press a button for sprint'. Move 'esc cancels' to the footer legend at 16px tx-2, and show 'b cancel' on pad.

P1 list rows and chips (all categories): category labels 16px tx-2 uppercase-free with +.04em tracking, no bold. Action names 20px tx-1 weight 600. Idle chips use --ui-raised fill and a --ui-line border. Keep --acc only on the waiting chip.

P1 bottom of list, 'world' row (ping, pause): snap the scroll so the focused row is fully visible, or add a 24px gradient mask to --ui-panel. Make the scrollbar 6px --ui-line-hi, with the thumb in tx-2.

P2 left edge alignment: pick one left edge: align the banner and list to x=49 with the title, or centre a 1440px column and align the title to it. Align category labels and action names to the same inset.

P2 footer 'reset to defaults' and 'esc close': make one 72px footer row: reset on the left, and on the right a legend 'b close · y reset' at 16px tx-2 with pad glyphs. Both items are vertically centred on the same line.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: the settings card is clean, consistent and all lower case, but the detail pane is a huge empty box, the stepper columns float mid-row, and the list is cut off at the bottom, so it still reads as a template options screen.
findings: P1 right detail pane (x=1088-1870, y=116-994): Narrow the pane to about 420px and give the freed width to the list. Or keep it full height and add a 56px f-cond 800 hero readout of the current value ('full') in --acc under the 32px title. Put the description 24px below the title at 20px f-body tx-1 and top-align it.

P1 stepper columns (chevrons x≈731 and x≈982, value x≈857, row x=338-1046): Right-align the cluster to the row edge: chevrons at x≈1000 and x≈1030 with a 160px value cell centred between them. Or shrink the list column to about 560px. Make the chevrons 20px, with tx-2 when idle and --acc when the row is focused.

P1 list bottom (rows 'crosshair' and 'crosshair colour', y≈900-994): End the viewport on a multiple of the 56px row height (for example y=952), 16px above the footer. Limit the fade to the last 24px. Make the thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, inset 8px from the border, with a visible track.

P1 left rail (x=50-313) idle items and 'send play data' (y=555): Set idle items to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 and the selected item to tx-1 on --ui-raised. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of space above 'send play data', and mark it as a utility link in 16px tx-2.

P2 focused row 'render resolution' (x=338-1046, y=117-171) and the detail pane top edge (y=116): Inset the list 8px from the top, or add a 1px --ui-line gap. Make the pane's top tab 36px wide, not full-width, so only the focused row carries the strong lime.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: The layout switcher and controller diagram give the screen a real hero and a purpose, but the pad drawing is crude with overlapping labels, the list is cramped and cut off, and the small text is too dim for a couch.
findings: P0 controller diagram, d-pad cluster and face buttons: Redraw the d-pad as a 96px cross with every label inside its arm (16px, centred). Make face buttons 40px circles on a 64px diamond. Keep stick labels in one line style, 20px. Give lb/lt/rb/rt matching 8px gaps. Draw the pad outline at about 60% line brightness (--ui-line-hi) so the labels read above it.

P1 left list pane (bottom rows and scrollbar): End the list on a whole row: pad the bottom by 8px and fade the last 24px. Restore the 3px accent tab on the group headers or bump them to tx-1 at 16px with +.04em. Show one focused row in --ui-raised with a lime 3px left bar so pad focus is visible.

P1 bottom-right legend table (lt/rt/lb/rb/view/...): Drop the table or the left list's duplicate role. If the table stays, raise the button names to tx-1 at 16px 600, set the action at 20px, and give the rows a 1px --ui-line divider. Align the column starts to the diagram's centre. Better: put the action text next to each diagram label as callouts and delete the table.

P1 layout selector (top-left): Make the box 48px high with arrows centred vertically (align to the 20px text centre). Render '1/6' in tx-2 and the preset name in tx-1 at 20px 700. Give the focused state a 2px lime border. Raise the label to 16px tx-2 at the 4.5:1 floor.

P2 header and divider rows: Centre the diagram in the pane (centre x of about 1232 against its current 1232? Measure it: the pad is at x 900-1565, so its centre is 1232, but the pane centre is 1232, which is fine). The real fix is to scale the diagram up 15% to fill the pane, and make the 24px gaps between rule, selector and content equal.

01-title-mode-menu.verdict: The busy sprite backdrop is gone and the menu now reads clearly on a calm dark vignette, but the gold gradient logo, the four same-weight mode rows and the cramped saves block are all still unchanged and generic.
findings: P1 pillagers logo (x 800-1120, y 290-370): Make the wordmark flat. Use tx-1 #efe9dc at 56px f-cond 800 with no gradient and no shadow, or use flat --acc. Remove the shadow.
