P1 top-right career column (credits, xp, stash, backpack): Use equal 40px rows with 8px gaps. Give the minimap the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and --rad 4. Make credits the only tx-1 row and the rest tx-2.

P1 panel consistency: pillager bots (top-left), run info (right), keys legend, ammo card (bottom-right): One panel component: 1px line-hi border, 16px padding, rad 4, a 16px tx-2 title and the chevron at the top-right in the same place. Set the contract text to 16px with 12px side padding. Replace the $ on the bots scoreboard with sp.
P1 bottom-right ammo card (scav pistol 12 / 24): Align the card's bottom edge to the hotbar's bottom edge at y=1058. Add 24px padding. Tie the tab to the card's left edge or the top-left corner.

91-public-news-window.verdict: A near-empty full-screen card whose content is a stray hero line and three plain rows floating in dead space, with no real hierarchy, no readable release notes, and a hard-to-see close button.
findings: P0 card body, left column 'new in v0.0993': Remove it, or fold it into the title row as a 16px tx-2 tag ('v0.0993') right of 'what's new'. Start the list at y≈216 (title divider + 40px) and give it the full card width.

P0 whole card, 1726x926 with about 60% empty: Top-align the list at 216px, with rows 72px tall at 20px type and 16px gaps. Add a 16px tx-2 sub-line under each row (e.g. where to find it). If the card must stay 90%, fill with a latest-first list of older versions, grouped under 16px section labels.

P1 rows 1-3 (x 901-1799): Make rows non-interactive: drop the raised fill and lime bar, and use tx-1 20px text with line dividers. Or make them open a detail pane, with the focused row in --ui-raised and the detail in a pane on the left, replacing the hero. Drop the numerals and use a 6px lime dot or nothing.

P1 close button top-right (1751-1799, 121-169): Set the title to 32px/700. Make the x glyph 24px in tx-1 inside a 48px box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 2px --acc focus ring. Add a 16px tx-2 'esc' hint left of it, or a live pad button glyph.

P1 card frame and background: Hide the career HUD while a window is open, or push the card down so it clears the HUD by 24px. Use --scrim at .80 and keep the 5% margin (96px) as the rule on all four sides.

91-public-report-recorder.verdict: A clean, on-guide settings card with a clear lime main action, but the content is a narrow column floating in a huge empty field, the raw log dump dominates, and small text and sentences hurt it.
findings: P1 content column (x 411-1509, y 280-840): Start content at 24px under the header rule (y~130). Widen the column to about 1500px, or split it into two panes: log on the left, restore on the right. Keep the gaps on the 8px grid.

P1 log textarea (y 317-497): Set the dump to 16px tx-2 in the mono-for-data style. Use --ui-raised fill with a 1px --ui-line border, and mute the text. Or show a short summary (runs, extracted, build) and leave the full dump behind copy. Make the scrollbar 8px wide and visible.

P1 restore a character helper line (y 686): Cut it to a short label, e.g. 'paste restore code'. Move the replace warning into a short 16px --warn tag beside the read code button, e.g. 'replaces your save'. Use at least 16px and 4.5:1 contrast.

P1 button row (copy to clipboard, clear recorder, read code): Use one height of 56px and 24px side padding for all. Put clear recorder beside copy, or demote it to a quiet text-danger button. Make read code a lime or secondary button that sits flush right under the input, not floating left.

P2 header (settings title, tabs, x): Put tabs at 20px f-cond 600, 32px after the title. Raise inactive tabs to --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Either make the 2px top tab clearly 36px wide with a real panel, or remove it.

85-after-mapfirst.verdict: The pre-raid screen now has a clear structure: map on the left, contracts on the right, a lime start button, and a card with an x. It still falls short of polished, because the map labels are cluttered and sit on dark chips, a few text sizes are too small, and the bottom-left stat is nearly invisible.
findings: P1 map area, labels: Cut the labels to the extracts, the player and the 3-4 key places. Show room names only on hover or focus, or at 14px tx-2 with no chip. Give every chip the same 4px radius, 6px by 3px padding and 80% --ui-panel fill. Move 'locked' into a small lock glyph.

P1 hierarchy, whole card: Drop the 'contracts' header to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-2, or make it a 16px label. Cut the hot-ground fill from about 25% to 12% opacity and keep the dashed outline. Keep the extract names at 20px but make the 'closes in' lines 16px tx-2.

P1 contracts list rows: Put the reward on the first line at 20px tx-1, and the progress as a 16px tx-2 line on the left under the name. Make the accent bar 3px lime on the active rows and label it ('active'). Use a uniform 72px row pitch with a 1px --ui-line divider, and give the 'holding' text --ok at 16px with a 4.5:1 contrast check.

P1 header row: Set both to 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 and baseline-align them to the title. Put 'dawn · clear' next to the X with a 16px gap. Give the X button the --ui-line-hi border at 1px and a 48px hit box.
P2 footer, bottom left: Put it in a pill of 16px tx-2 text with a thin 120px progress bar. Or merge it into the map panel's corner. Keep the footer to a 72px row with 24px padding.

86b-cold-mile-night.verdict: The HUD is readable and all lower case, but it is a pile of small, dim, unrelated boxes with no hero element, and the type sizes, panels and accent colours don't follow the guide.
findings: P0 top-right: career box and run info box: Cut run info to a 16px label row ('night · storm'). Move the effect text to a tooltip or delete it. Show contracts as three rows at 16px with a right-aligned count. Build the career block as one list of equal rows (cash, stash, backpack, xp) using the same panel (--ui-panel 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding). Align it to the 48px margin.

P1 center top: 8:59 timer and 'extract 166m' chip: Make the timer 56px f-cond 800 in --tx-1 (--fs-hero). Make the extract chip 20px with 8px padding. Delete the storm banner sentence and keep only a 16px 'storm' tag. Leave 16px between the timer and the chip.

P1 bottom-right ammo card 'scav pistol 12 / 24' and 'b / i backpack': Right-align the name, ammo and items line on one 24px inner margin. Move 'b / i backpack' to a 14px muted legend under the card, or into a key chip like the 'f' and 'use' chips. Set the name to 20px --tx-2 and the numerals to 56px 800, with 12 in --tx-1 and '/ 24' in --tx-2. Make the accent tab 36px wide by 2px, flush with the card edge.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre: Draw the owned guns at 100% and the empty slots at 35%. Make the key numbers 16px. Use the --acc lime 2px border for the active slot only, and drop the blue fill on 4 (use a 3px rarity bar at the bottom edge). Place the 'fire / use' hints with an 8px gap above the bar at 16px, or move them next to the ammo card.

P1 left, 'current pillager bots 16' list: Cut it to the top 5 rows plus 'you'. Use --tx-1 for names and --tx-2 for values, and --acc only for 'you'. Remove the amber header and the purple name, or move the purple to a 3px bar on the left of the row. Use tabular figures for the $ column. Align the panel's left edge to the 48px margin to match the other panels.

86b-raid-night.verdict: The raid HUD has good bones (a clear ammo hero number and a readable hotbar), but it is a scatter of mismatched panels with too many type sizes and too many accent colours. It has not reached the one-hot-accent look of ARC Raiders.
findings: P0 top-right stack (cash/stash, run info, contracts): Collapse it into one vertical list with every row the same size. Use 20px values in tx-1 and 16px labels in tx-2, with 8px row padding. Remove the 'night foggy / sight -40%' block, or reduce it to one icon row. Show at most one active contract line.

P0 top-left 'current pillager bots 3' scoreboard: Use one header colour (tx-2) and white rows. Mark 'you' with a 3px lime left bar on a --ui-raised row fill. Keep the purple only if it is a per-player tint, but the owner has not answered that question, so drop it. Match the 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius to the other panels.
P1 whole HUD, panel family: Use one panel component: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding, no slanted corner. Put the lime 3px tab only on the weapon panel as the star.

P1 colour use: amber text, teal pill, lime, cyan 'extraction c available', green hp, blue stamina: Keep the colours semantic: --extract teal only for the extract timer and prompt, --warn amber only as a small glyph, lime only for focus and the active weapon. Make 'concealed · in cover' tx-1 with a small amber glyph. Make the amber panel header tx-2.

P1 bottom-left 'standing' / stamina / hp: Make hp 16px thin and secondary, with a 20px numeric value in tx-1 inside a 12px bar. Make stamina a 6px bar in tx-2. Fold 'standing' into the bar label, or make it a plain 16px tx-2 word. Put both in one 5%-margin group aligned to the hotbar's left edge.

p1-1080.verdict: This is a different screen from the one I reviewed before, a yes/no prompt over a live raid. The lime yes button is clear and the card is clean, but the card overlaps the HUD and has dead space and weak yes/no styling.
findings: P1 card, x492-1427 y261-579: Centre the card at y540 (y375-705). Add a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer behind it, with an optional 4px blur, so the HUD and map drop to about 40% brightness.

P1 title row, x539-1382 y315-360: Reduce the title-to-button gap to 32px. Turn the countdown into a 16px tx-2 '11s' aligned to the title baseline, or a thin 3px lime bar that drains along the card top edge.

P1 buttons, x539-1382 y432-533: Make both buttons 64px tall. Keep yes as the lime fill. Give no a 1px --ui-line-hi border with tx-1 text, so it is clearly a button. Add a 2px lime focus ring when no is selected. Keep the 32px gap between the buttons.
P2 button labels, x711-772 y470-497: Put the key in a 28px keycap (1px border, 16px text) beside the 20px 600 'yes' label. On pad, swap the keycap for the pad button glyph.
P2 card top edge, x492-562 y261-264: Either make it a full-width 3px timer bar, or align it to the x539 content edge at 64px wide.

p2-1080.verdict: This frame is a raid screenshot with a 'want easy mode?' modal, not the player 2 title I reviewed before, and the modal is a flat black box with a glaring lime fill that has no hierarchy or craft behind it.
findings: P0 screen identity (whole frame): Re-capture the real p2 title screen. If this modal is meant to be the p2 screen, say so, and give it the title composition from my earlier review.

P1 modal card (x 493-1427, y 261-579): Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use --ui-panel fill on an 80% --scrim over the whole screen. Centre the card at y 540 and make it 880x360. Make the top edge either a full-width 4px lime bar or nothing.

P1 'y yes' button (x 539-945, y 432-533): Cut the button to 64px tall. Use 24px f-cond 700 text in --acc-ink and put the 'y' key hint in a 28x28 chip at the left. Keep it as the only lime fill. Decide the default deliberately, since lime should mean 'selected'.

P1 'n no' button (x 976-1382, y 432-533): Fill it --ui-raised with a 2px --ui-line-hi border and --tx-1 label. Show a 3px lime focus outline on whichever button holds pad focus. Use the same 64px height as the yes button.

P1 title 'want easy mode?' (x 539-790, y 316-350): Set the title at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1, with a 16px --tx-2 line below it that states the effect in 6 words or fewer. Make the countdown a 40px hero-style number in a 56px ring or bar, tinted --tx-2. Cut the gap to 32px between the title block and the buttons.

pix86c-fashion.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a good pixel turntable and a clear tab bar, but the eye has no single place to land, the tiles are cluttered and low contrast, and the left list and a stray toast are rough.
findings: P1 head tile grid, whole rack: Make the worn tile a 2px --acc border with an accent-ink 'worn' tag. Drop the lock icon on locked tiles and dim the sprite to 50% instead. Make the rarity bar a 3px top bar, not a full coloured outline. Keep the name at 20px tx-1 and the unlock line at 16px tx-2.

P1 tile text (names and unlock lines): Name 20px f-cond 600 tx-1, unlock line 16px tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Pull both under the sprite with 8px between them. Shorten the long unlock strings, for example '2 wardens (0/2)'.

P1 left column, 'your operator' list: Cut the left list to the slots that have no rack, or turn it into 16px labels over 20px values with a 56px row height and no scrollbar. Enlarge the preview to about 70% of the column and centre a 24px-tall rim light under it. Add a visible focus bar (--acc 3px left edge) on the focused row.

P1 header row and subtitle: Delete the subtitle sentence. Keep only '$900' as the hero at 32px tx-1, and make the stash/bag and xp 16px tx-2 and right-aligned. Drop 'xp' if it is 0. Space everything on the 8px grid with 24px between groups.

P2 bottom toast 'the welcome pack is in your stash.': Move it fully outside the card or into the card's footer row. Use a standard panel with 16px text and no sentence ending, for example 'welcome pack in stash'. Make it fade out after 3 seconds.

pix86c-looks.verdict: This is a diagnostic contact sheet, not a player-facing menu: the character art is clean and readable, but the screen has no hierarchy, no panel, no title or close and no focus state, so it fails the style guide.
findings: P1 whole screen: If it is dev-only, keep it out of the shipped build and the UI critic set. If a player can see it, put it in a card: fill #16191b at 90%, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 24px padding, 32px title, x in the top-right corner.
P1 header text, top-left: Title at 32px f-cond 700 tx-1. Section labels at 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking, in tx-2 (#aaa498). Add 24px of space above each section.

P1 4x grid, 27 looks: Under each cell add a 14 to 16px tx-2 label such as 'tan / ponytail / 2'. Group the 9 columns with a 1px #2e3337 divider. Put the row headers 'bare', 'braid' and 'hooded' down the left edge.

P1 layout balance: Use a 5% margin (96px by 54px) and a two-column layout: the grid on the left, the in-game preview on the right in a titled panel with a 1px border. Align the preview top edge with the first grid row.
P2 1x row, top: Add 16px labels 'players' and 'pillager bots' above each strip, and a 1px divider between them. Give the strips 16px of padding above and below.

pix86c-raid.verdict: The pixel art world reads well, but the HUD is a pile of mismatched panels with five accent colours, three corners of dense text, and no clear hero number, so it looks like a prototype and not a shipped game.
findings: P0 top-right: cash/stash panel and run info panel: Collapse run info by default to a single 20px line (contract 1 of 3). Show the full list only on a held key. Give both panels the same 16px padding and 8px gap, and put a 24px margin from the screen edge. Make the progress counts right-aligned tx-2 16px. Use one status colour (--ok) for done lines only.

P0 whole HUD: colour use: Switch the amber elements (bots header, toast bar and text, selected slot border, status pill text) to tx-1 text with a 3px --acc left bar, and keep --warn only for real warnings. Reserve teal for the extraction chip and arrow. Make the selected slot border and the ammo underline --acc.

P1 bottom-right weapon panel: Use a --ui-panel fill at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Put the name on the left (20px tx-2) and the hero number on the right (56px 800). Make the ammo reserve 20px tx-2. Move the backpack line to a 16px footer row. Align the left edges of all rows. Keep a 3px --acc left tab instead of the stray tick.

P1 bottom-left: status 'standing', stamina bar, hp bar: Draw both bars on a --ui-panel backing 8px high and 360px wide. Set the labels outside the bars at 16px tx-2 with the value at 20px tx-1. Make hp the taller bar (16px) and stamina thin (6px). Drop 'standing' to the same 16px label as the other tags, with no pill.

P1 left: current pillager bots panel: Shrink to 320px wide with 16px labels and 8px row gaps. Use the same panel P (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 24px padding) as on the right. Restyle 'f1 controls' as a 16px --fs-label key hint at the footer legend size, with no box.

pix86c-raid-aims.verdict: This is a raid screen with two debug art-test panels pasted over it (an aim-direction sheet across the top, a comparison inset at bottom right), so the real HUD is half hidden and the screen does not read as a shippable game view.
findings: P0 top overlay, 8 aim directions sheet (about y 15 to 505, full width): Keep it out of the shipped HUD layer. If it must stay as a review shot, render it as a separate image, not over the raid. Otherwise cap it at 25% of screen height and move it off the top-right HUD corner.

P0 bottom right, two inset comparison panels ('now - raid size' / 'pixel test - raid size', x 1265 to 1905, y 825 to 1065): Remove from the raid layer. If kept for review, give the insets a 24px margin from the screen edge and the 16px minimum label size, and keep them clear of the hotbar and status text.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre (x 565 to 1265): Use one focus style: a 2px --acc border plus a --ui-raised fill on the active slot only. Make unselected slots flat --ui-panel with a --ui-line-hi border. Anchor the tag to the active slot at 16px, with a single chip background.

P1 bottom left HUD (standing / stamina / hp 100): Make the hp bar 12px tall with the 56px hero number set separately beside it, one corner tick only. Use the same --rad 4px panel for 'standing'. Keep a 48px bottom margin (the --sp-5 space token). Move stamina to a thin 6px line under hp, in --tx-2 instead of blue.

P1 left callouts ('codex entry - scav pistol - common', 'contract item nearby', x 15 to 315, y 740 to 797): Use one pill component: same height of 28px, 16px text, 3px left bar in the rarity colour (--r-common #9da3a8 here, warn amber for contract). Align the left edge to the 5% margin (96px) shared with the HUD, with an 8px gap between pills.

pix86c-native4k.verdict: The raid HUD is readable and all lower case, but it is a pile of equal-weight small boxes with mixed type sizes and no clear lead element, and it looks like a template.
findings: P0 top-right: cash/stash and run info panels: Build the 1x1 vertical list at a uniform 20px/16px scale. Use a 24px margin, one panel width (about 320px), and a tx-2 label with a tx-1 value. Drop the chevron. Move 'no downs yet' into the same left-aligned column as the other rows.

P0 bottom-right ammo panel: Put the weapon name at 16px tx-2 top-left and the 56px count on the right. Reduce the footer to one 16px tx-2 line ('backpack $1,620'). Anchor the tab flush at the left edge. Align the right padding to 24px.

P1 top-left: current pillager bots: Make the heading tx-2 16px and show the player row in lime only. Use 28px row height, 1px --ui-line dividers, and a 24px margin. Use the same panel treatment as the career list.

P1 centre top: timer, extract 152m, contract toast: Make the timer 56px f-cond 800 tx-1. Shorten the toast to 'contract item nearby'. Delete the duplicate bottom-left entry. Use a single toast stack at 16px.

P1 bottom-left: standing, stamina, hp: Both bars 12px high on a --ui-line track. Fill hp with --ok and stamina with a muted tx-2. Put 'hp 100' at 20px outside the bar, above it. Use the same 4px radius as the other panels. Margin 24px.

86e-pixel-props-sheet.verdict: A clean, lower-case dev sheet that follows the tokens, but the sprites are tiny and drift around their cells, the type is under the size floor, and the opened variants read as dark blobs instead of open containers.
findings: P1 all four cells, sprite placement: Centre each closed/opened pair horizontally in its cell with a fixed 48px gap, bottom-align every sprite to one baseline 32px above the cell bottom, and scale the sprites to 8x so they fill about 60% of the cell height.

P1 opened variants (crate, safe, strongbox, locker): Lighten the interior to about #2a2630 with a 2px lit rim on the top edge. Show a hint of contents or a depth gradient. Attach the lid hinge to the body with no gap, and give the opened locker a full-width door swung out at about 30 degrees. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi light outline to every sprite so it separates from the panel.

P1 header "containers" and the "closed / opened / 6x" subtitle: Title 32px f-cond 700. Cell labels 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Drop "6x" and the slash string, and replace the subtitle with 16px tx-2 "closed" and "opened" captions under each sprite.
P2 cell panels: Remove the label divider. Use --ui-raised #1e2225 for the sprite stage with a 4px radius and no border. Mark one featured cell with the 3px lime left tab.
P2 accent rule above the title: Move the tab onto the card's top edge at y=163, 36px wide per the guide, or drop it.

86e-pixel-raid-street.verdict: The pixel-art world reads well, but the HUD is a crowd of small boxes in different sizes, fills and accents. Nothing is the clear hero except the ammo number, and the top-right card text is dense and tiny.
findings: P1 top-right: cash/stash card, run info card, 'extraction c available' tag: Make one panel width (about 300px) with 24px padding and 8px row gaps. Use tx-2 16px labels and tx-1 20px values. Keep green only for completed contracts. Fix the 'crlers' string. Put 'extraction c available' in the same panel style and move it into the column.

P1 HUD overall hierarchy: Treat the 8:55 timer as a second hero at --fs-hero 56px f-cond 800 (or at least 40px) with a 2px top tab. Change the extract pill to a 4px-radius panel with an --extract teal text and a 3px left tab, matching the other panels. Dim the secondary cards to --ui-panel at 80%.

P1 top-left 'current pillager bots 0' card: Use tx-1 for the title at 20px and tx-2 at 16px for rows. Remove the amber. Show a single 'out 0 / dead 3' line only. Pad 16px and set the dead rows to --danger text at 16px.

P1 bottom-left: standing / stamina / hp 100: Give both bars the same 20px height, a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put the labels in 16px tx-1 with 8px inset. Show hp in --ok and stamina in a desaturated blue. Align the 'standing' tab to the same left edge and grid.

P2 bottom-centre hotbar and its tooltip tabs: Make the key hints 16px in one 32px strip with a single fill. Use --acc for the selected slot border (2px). Reduce the empty-slot silhouettes to 25% opacity.

86e-pixel-barrels-sheet.verdict: A tidy dev sprite sheet with consistent lower-case labels and a lime tab, but the labels are too small, the sprites sit off-centre in their tiles, and the sheet fills only a small strip of a mostly empty screen.
findings: P1 barrels header and '6x' tag: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Delete '6x', or change it to '4' to match the cards. If it stays, use 16px tx-2.
P1 card labels (red/shock/acid/cryo): Set labels to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1, with 16px of padding. Drop the divider or use --ui-line at 1px with 16px of space above the sprite.
P1 sprite placement in cards: Centre each sprite horizontally and vertically in the area below the label (24px padding all round). Or scale the sprites 1.5x so they fill about 60% of the card height.
P1 overall screen composition: Fill the 90% card layout, or scale the sprites to 2x (about 280px). Bring the title and footer into the layout at 5% margins.

P2 sprite palette vs UI: Keep the sprites as art, but add a small 16px tag under each ('explodes', 'shocks', 'burns', 'freezes') in tx-2. Or show a rarity-style 3px bar in the effect colour at the card's bottom edge.

86e-pixel-wrecks-sheet.verdict: A tidy dark spec sheet with a clean title, but the wreck art is tiny and low-contrast inside oversized empty panels, so it reads as a debug contact sheet rather than a polished screen.
findings: P0 botwreck panel: Raise the sprite value so it reaches at least 3:1 against --ui-raised. Add a 1px rim light or a lighter ground shadow. Scale the sprite up 2x, to about 220px wide.
P1 all five panels: Crop each panel to its art with 24px padding. Scale the sprites so they fill about 70% of the panel height. Centre the pair vertically.
P1 every panel: Add a 16px --tx-2 label under each sprite ('closed', 'opened'), or one column header per column, with 8px spacing.
P1 sentry panel and grid layout: Use a 3-column grid, or span the sentry panel across the full width. Alternatively put a warden-sized legend or palette key in the empty slot.
P2 panel titles: Use 20px --fs-body 600 for the titles and 16px padding above the rule. Make the rule --ui-line rather than a bright line.

86e-pixel-salvage-sheet.verdict: This is a clean asset review sheet that follows the type and palette tokens, but it is not a game screen. The sprites are tiny in oversized cells, there is no hierarchy, and the sprites are uneven in size and position.
findings: P1 all cells, sprite size: Scale the sprites up to 8x, or to about 60% of the cell height (~200px). Shrink the cells to about 320px tall, or fit the sheet to its content.

P1 body and carcass cells, closed / opened pairs: Add 'closed' and 'opened' captions in tx-2 at 16px under each sprite. Give the body and carcass a visible state change, such as a looted pocket turned out, or a bone and flesh colour shift. Give the opened chests a lit interior with a rim highlight.

P1 body, carcass and box sprites, contrast: Lift the mid-tone values of the three brown sets by about 20% and add a 1px light rim or highlight. Check them on the real floor tiles, not only on this panel.
P2 cell layout, vertical placement: Centre each pair on a shared midline in its cell, with the same 80px gap between closed and opened sprites in every cell.
P2 sheet grid, bottom-right: Use a 5-across single row, or a 3+3 grid with a sixth item. Otherwise centre the last row.

86e-pixel-wrecks-detail.verdict: A tidy, consistent dark contact sheet with correct lower case and a clear title, but the art sits small and dim in oversized empty cards, the labels are tiny and the layout is unbalanced.
findings: P1 all five cards, sprite area: Scale the sprites to 4x or 5x so each fills about 60% of its card width. Add a 16px 'closed' and 'opened' caption in tx-2 under each sprite. Lift the ground shadow so it reads as a pool of dark against the panel. Trim card height by about 30%.
P1 layout, last row (peddler): Use a 3-column grid (3+2, with a left-aligned last row), or a 5-up row. Pin every sprite to a shared baseline at a fixed 24px from the card bottom.
P1 header, 'closed / opened / 3x': Remove '3x'. Set the sub-label at 16px in tx-2 (#aaa498) and keep the 32px title. Drop the '/ 2' or move it to a 14px page stamp at the right.
P2 card titles (crawler, bulwark, ...): Set card titles to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1. Make the divider --ui-line (#2e3337) at 1px, or remove it.
P2 outer frame and cards: Fill cards with --ui-panel #16191b at 90%, borders --ui-line-hi #4a5257, and use consistent 24px padding with 48px outer margins on the 8px grid.

86f-machines-lineup.verdict: it follows the card, x and lower-case rules, but it is a dev sprite sheet with a dead left column and a bright green reference photo that outshouts the title and the machines.
findings: P0 left column, reference image: remove it from the player screen or move it to a dev-only view. If it stays, desaturate it to about 40%, shrink it to a 240px thumbnail, and keep it inside a --ui-panel tile with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 left column, empty space: drop the column and use a full-width 3x3 grid (about 1680px wide, 24px gaps), or make the left side a detail pane in --ui-raised that shows the focused machine at 2x with its name and 2 stat lines.

P1 grid tiles, sprite scale and baseline: use equal tile heights (about 280px). Anchor every sprite to a shared baseline 56px above the bottom, with 16px minimum top padding. Scale small sprites up to at least 96px, or add a size bar. Scale the overseer down so it clears the top by 24px.
P1 tile labels: add a focus state: --acc 2px border plus a --ui-raised fill on the focused tile, with a 3px lime bar on the left edge. Make the arrow keys and d-pad move between tiles.
P2 title row: set the header row to exactly 56px, with the title baseline centred on the x button, and 24px padding under the divider.

86f-machines-raid-day.verdict: A clean dev-only proof card that follows the window rules (centred, x in the corner, lower case, lime title tab), but it is a label sheet on a loud purple and orange floor and not a designed screen, and several small details are sloppy.
findings: P1 Art area, machine labels and the player sprite: Move the player sprite at least 40px clear of the label row, or hide it for the proof. Use one label style for every machine. Keep the underline only if it means something, and add a legend for it.

P1 Art area background: Put the proof on a neutral --ui-raised (#1e2225) or a flat mid-grey floor. Or dim the scene to about 60% brightness so the machines are the brightest thing. This also makes the lime title tab read as the one accent.
P1 Overseer and the grey building at lower right: Draw the scene with the props off, or move the overseer at least 100px from any prop. A proof sheet needs unobstructed sprites.
P2 Bottom-left of the art area (~125-400px, y 932-944): Remove it, or move it into the footer row if it is needed. If it stays, use a 2px --ui-line-hi track with an --acc fill.

P2 Title row, footer and inner frame: Remove the inner border and give the art a 16px gap inside the card. Raise the footer text to 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Drop 'esc / close', since the X already does the job.

86f-machines-raid-night.verdict: A clean dev-only proof card that follows the window pattern (centred card, x in the corner, lime tab on the title, lower-case text), but the proof art pane has crowding, overlap and weak label craft, and it isn't a real player screen.
findings: P1 art pane, 'crier' label and the player character: Move the player sprite out of the label row, or move the player 60px lower. Put each label at a fixed 12px below its own sprite's shadow, not at a shared baseline.
P1 overseer and golden warden, bottom row: Leave at least 48px between neighbouring sprites. Shift the overseer 80px right and move the building out from behind it.
P1 art pane, whole image: For a proof sheet, put a flat #16191b backdrop behind the sprites, or raise the sprite rim light so the sprite-to-floor luminance ratio is at least 3:1.
P2 sprite name labels: Make all pills the same height (28px) with 8px side padding, use one underline rule (rarity colour on the 3px bar only), and size the text at 16px with +.04em tracking.
P2 layout of the sprite grid: Put every sprite's ground shadow at a shared y per row and pin the labels 12px under it. Move the player out of the grid.

86g-death-strip.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a lime-focused x and a clear grid, but it reads as a developer sprite sheet: the title is tiny, the labels are tiny, and the bottom strip is cramped.
findings: P1 title 'death' top-left: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1 and put 24px of padding between it and the divider line.

P1 bottom strip 'light and bot fade' (labels and cells): Raise the strip label to 16px tx-2 with 16px of space above it. Make the fade cells 8px apart on a --ui-raised fill so the dark states show. Set the fade labels to 16px tx-2 weight 600, and show the 0.88 and 0.69 states with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.
P1 '1x' tags in each frame, bottom-right: Remove the per-frame '1x' text. Add one legend line in the footer ('small sprite = 1x'), or keep only the small sprite and move it 16px from the frame edge.
P2 header right: 'esc close' and the x button: Set the hint to 14px minimum (16px label preferred) in tx-2 and use a 16px gap to the button. Keep the x at 48-52px.
P2 frame numbers 1-8 below each tile: Put the number inside the tile top-left at 16px tx-2, or keep it below at 16px with 8px between tile and number and 24px between rows.

86g-fight-day.verdict: This is a dev reference sheet in a window frame, not a player-facing screen. The 56px-style header is there, but the bottom 165px is dead space and the content is a flat strip of labelled sprites with no hierarchy.
findings: P0 bottom of card, y 860-1025: Fit the card to its content, or scale the strip to fill the body (about 1676x860). Alternatively fill the space with a second row of states. Keep a 24px gap above a 72px footer.

P1 sprite strip, all 8 labels: Use tx-1 labels at 16px on --ui-panel. Colour a 3px bar under each label by state: golden gets --r-gold, alert gets --warn, elite gets --r-elite. Group by row, with the row names as 16px tx-2 labels.
P1 image area, y 160-860: Wrap the strip in a panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Dim the backdrop by about 35%, for example a --scrim overlay, so the sprites carry the contrast.

P1 title 'day fight' (top-left, 32px): Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 and the 'esc close' hint to 16px tx-2 (14px is the minimum). Add a subtitle such as 'pillager states' at 16px tx-2 if the context is needed.
P2 close button (top-right, 1750-1800 x 85-137): Remove the 'esc close' text. Keep the X at 40px with a --ui-line-hi border at rest, and show lime only on focus.

86g-fight-night.verdict: Clean, consistent card shell with lower case text and a clear focused close button, but the content is a dev-looking contact sheet with a big dead band below and tiny, low-contrast header text.
findings: P1 bottom of the card, y 860 to 1025: Scale the image to fill the card body (about 1676x940 area) or centre the content vertically. Otherwise shrink the card to fit the content. Keep a 24px bottom padding.

P1 the whole screen, hierarchy: Frame it as a real screen: put a 16px tx-2 sub-label row under the title or a lime 2px tab on the title. Group the 8 sprites into a 4x2 grid of 24px-padded tiles with 1px --ui-line borders. Pick one featured state at the hero size.
P1 'esc close' hint, top right (x 1682 to 1735): Set it to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 (at least 4.5:1) with 16px of gap to the button. Or drop it and keep only the X.
P1 sprite name tags, 8 labels: Use 20px f-cond 600 tags on --ui-void at 85%, 8px padding, centred 16px under the feet. Give the duplicate a distinct name (for example 'armour 3 alt').

P2 image area, x 122 to 1798: Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius to the image. Make the gap under the header rule 24px. Crop or clean the stray tan patches at (1385,230) and (1385,600) and at (345,745).

86g-hurt-strip.verdict: A clean, consistent dev-style sprite sheet in the shared card shell, with a lime-focused x and lower-case text, but the section labels are too small and dim, the bottom of the card is empty, and the screen reads as a debug sheet instead of a game screen.
findings: P1 section labels 'hit and health states' and 'armour and civilians': Set them to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 (#aaa498, 4.5:1 or better), and add a 1px --ui-line rule under each, matching the title divider.

P1 header close hint 'esc close' and x button: Raise the hint to 16px --tx-2 and leave a 16px gap before the x. Keep the x at 48px with a 24px inset from the card edge, and keep the lime border only for the focused state.

P1 card bottom (y 950 to 1025): Distribute the row gaps evenly (the 24px sp-3 gap between sections becomes 32px), or centre the grid vertically, so top and bottom padding are both 24px and the tile rows fill the card.

P2 row 1 thumbnail strips under the tiles: Add a 'small size' label at 16px, or drop the strip and show one tile size. If it stays, put it in both rows and align it to the same 8px grid with 16px gaps.

P2 tile captions ('white hit', 'red hit', 'armour 1'): Set the captions to 16px --tx-2 and the section labels to 20px --tx-1. Add a tier marker, a rarity bar or a number badge, to the armour tiles so the difference is readable at couch distance.

86h-fashion.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card that follows the guide (lower case, lime focus, x in the corner), but the type is small and quiet, the hierarchy is flat, and the bottom of both panels is empty.
findings: P1 rack tiles (head, skin, clothes, set): Give the focused tile a --ui-raised fill, a 3px lime left bar and a 2px lime border. Make 'worn' tx-2 with a small check glyph, or --ok green, so lime means focus only.

P1 preview panel, 'your pillager': Scale the sprite up 1.5x to 2x with nearest-neighbour filtering, centre it on a floor shadow, and delete the stray dash or turn it into the 3px panel accent tab. Show the equipped set name under the sprite at 20px.

P1 header currency row, top right: Use one style for the whole row: 20px f-cond 600, with labels in tx-2 at 16px. Drop 'bag $0' or put the stash on a second line. Leave 24px between the row and the x.

P1 'looks' save slots (left panel): Set the label and row text to 16px or larger with a 48px row height. Make 'surprise me' the one filled lime button (acc-ink text on a lime fill) and keep 'save' as an idle outline button. Highlight the selected slot.

P2 section headings 'head', 'skin', 'clothes', 'set': Make headings 16px tx-2 uppercase-free with a 1px divider line. Use 3 or 4 equal columns throughout, or give the set row its own labelled section with a clear break.

86h-pixbench-sets.verdict: This is a debug sprite sheet, not a wardrobe menu: it has no selection, no equipped state, no pad focus and no action, and its labels are tiny and misaligned.
findings: P0 whole screen: Turn it into a column list of outfits on the left (row height 56, 20px names, one lime focus bar 3px wide). Put one large preview of the focused outfit on the right, with a single primary 'equip' button. Delete the 3-card by 6-pose grid.

P1 pose labels (front, mirror / seat trim, crouch, roll): Set the labels at 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2, 8px above each sprite, on one shared baseline. Rename or drop the jargon. Show only front plus one small pose strip, or remove the labels.

P1 sprite sizing and card spacing: Use one integer pixel scale per view, and set card padding to 24px. Centre the hero sprite in the card, with its pose strip at a fixed 8px grid gap. Make the roll sprite at least 2x larger or remove it.
P1 card titles (skeleton, trooper, android): Keep the window title at 32px. Use 20px names, and add a rarity bar (3px) and an owned or equipped tag at 16px.
P2 window header: Set the title at 32px / 700. Make the header row 56px, with a full-width 1px divider. Give the X an idle --ui-line-hi border, and show lime only when it is focused.

86h-raid.verdict: The card frame is clean and consistent with the window rules: lime tab, lower case title, and an x that has a visible focus ring. As a screen it is only a bare art preview with no way to tell what it is for, and the preview art is washed out.
findings: P1 whole card body: Shrink the preview to about 60% of the card width in a --ui-raised pane. Add a left column of selectable rows (20px f-cond, 56px rows, lime 3px focus bar). Put the item name in the 32px title and the stats or recipe in 16px labels.

P1 preview art, bottom wall and left strip: Clip or crop the preview to the player area and remove the wall overlay haze (alpha 0.35 down to 0). Clean up the dark pixel debris at x=1350-1375 and the corner at x=190-310.
P1 title bar, 'raid / skeleton': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Use a plain label such as 'skeleton' with a 16px tx-2 sub-label. Make the divider --ui-line-hi.
P2 preview frame, margins: Wrap the image in a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius and padding of 24px inside a --ui-panel, and keep the insets equal on all sides.
P2 close button: Keep the focus ring. Make the idle x outline --ui-line-hi and use lime only when focused. Add a 16px key hint such as 'esc' beside it.

86j-pixel-firefight.verdict: A clean dev-only comparison card with correct lower case, a lime-focused close x and consistent card chrome, but the captions are too small and dim for 1080, the title is weak, and the three crops are all the same scene.
findings: P1 captions 'ignition', 'blast and debris', 'smoke and scorch': Set them to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498) or tx-1, with 12px of space under the image and left-aligned to the image edge. Use 20px if they are meant to be the panel titles.

P1 footer 'dev only, 2x game pixels' / 'esc / back': Delete 'dev only, 2x game pixels', or fold it into the title as a tag. Drop the footer's 'esc / back', or make it a 16px key hint in tx-2 with the key in a small chip. Remove the 72px footer row if nothing is left.

P1 title 'pixel firefight': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 with 24px padding. Either mark one panel as the star with a 3px lime top tab, or accept an equal layout but drop the full-width divider under the title.
P2 the three image panels: Crop each panel to its effect and leave out the shield bubble pickup. If the pickup has to stay, show it once. Alternatively draw the label at 50% alpha.
P2 panel borders and gutters: Use 24px gutters, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius on each image. Apply the same 24px padding to the card edge.

86j-pixel-night.verdict: A clean, consistent dev-only card: lower case, lime-focused x, flat dark panel and a large preview that dominates the screen. It is a plain template window with weak type hierarchy and low-contrast, tiny secondary text.
findings: P1 caption 'standing pillager, blast, shield pickup' under the image: Delete it, or raise it to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498). Put the caption inside the 24px padding with 16px spacing above and below.
P1 footer left 'dev only, native game pixels': Delete it or move it to a --fs-fine (14px) version stamp. Keep only the footer legend on the right, in the 72px footer row.
P1 title 'pixel night raid': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in a 56px header row, and give the image a 1px --ui-line-hi border so it reads as one framed element.
P2 close button top-right (1755-1802, 80-126): Make the button 48x48 at 24px inset, with a 2px --acc border only when focused. Use an 18px glyph at weight 600 and a 1px --ui-line-hi border when idle.
P2 card layout margins and dividers: Use 24px padding on all sides, 16px between image and caption, 24px between caption and footer divider. Use the same 1px --ui-line on both dividers.

86j-pixel-two-window.verdict: A clean, consistent dev-only card with a clear lime hero number and a visible focused close button, but the hero is a meaningless 0.0 ms, the two panels are weakly labelled and unbalanced, and the card is smaller than the 90 percent window rule.
findings: P1 hero number '0.0 ms' with 'p95 change': Make the hero the verdict: '31.7 ms' at 56px f-cond 800, with 'budget passed' as a 16px --ok tag. Demote the delta to a 16px --tx-2 line, e.g. 'change 0.0 ms'.

P1 player 1 / player 2 columns: Put each column in a panel (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding). Label at 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking, value at 32px --tx-1, image flush below with a 16px gap.

P1 card size and placement: Align the images to the 120px text margin and make each fill its column width exactly (about 840px). Keep the same left edge as the labels, or extend the card to about 90 percent of the height with a 48px margin.

P2 footer 'dev only, v33.94, budget passed': Move 'budget passed' up as an --ok tag next to the hero. Keep 'dev only, v33.94' as the 14px footer. Drop 'esc / back' or show it as a key chip, since the X already exists.
P2 title row: Set the title row to 56px high with the title and X both centred on its midline. Use a 2px --acc outline on focus only, and make idle X borders --ui-line-hi.

87r-groundmode-returning-raid.verdict: The raid HUD is readable but looks like a stack of unrelated boxes. The career card, minimap, run info and leaderboard each use a different size and edge, and the HUD has no hero element beyond the ammo count.
findings: P1 top-right stack (cash/stash card, minimap, run info): Build the 1x1 list from the pending cw-trcol work. Give every row the same 16px label in tx-2 and the same 20px value in tx-1, left-aligned label and right-aligned value. Use one 320px panel width for the whole column and 8px gaps between panels.

P1 current pillager bots leaderboard (left): Collapse it to the top 3 plus 'you' by default. Draw the 'you' row on --ui-raised with a 3px --acc bar. Change the header colour to tx-2 at 16px. Set row height to 24px and use f-cond 600 with tabular numerals.

P1 bottom-right ammo card: Delete the backpack line from the card, since the top-right already shows it. Keep the weapon name at 16px tx-2 and the ammo at 56px/800. Set the card padding to 24px. Align the 3px accent tab flush with the card's top-left corner, or remove it.

P1 run info panel (right): Show the contracts as 3 rows with a 16px tx-2 label and a right-aligned '0/1' in 20px. Merge weather and sight onto one line. Make the 'contracts' label 16px tx-2. Put 16px padding inside the panel.

P2 bottom-left stamina/hp bars: Use a single 8px-tall bar style with the label above in 16px tx-1 and the value on the right. Keep hp green and take stamina off saturated blue (use tx-2 on a --ui-line track). Fold 'standing' into a small 16px label under the bars.

intel-after-map-greyscale.verdict: The card frame is clean and consistent: title, an x in the corner, a footer with a key chip and a two-column map and contracts split. The map is cluttered with overlapping labels, there is no obvious focal point, and several type sizes are too small for a couch.
findings: P1 map, east cluster (blast freezer, strongbox, cache x5, extract b): Show one 'cache x5' label per cluster and offset it 24px clear of the icons. Collision-nudge the labels so no two overlap. Give extract labels priority and hide room names that collide with them.

P1 map, labels and key points: Make the extracts the hero: 24px f-cond 800 in tx-1 with a 2px ring on the icon. Set room names to 14px --tx-2 with no shadow. Make the player arrow 28px and give it a 2px halo. Keep the other labels at 16px minimum.

P1 header ('sector map' and 'elites and keys are live intel'): Delete the sentence. Keep 'intel live' as one 16px tag on the map or in the header. Align the title and subtitle on one baseline with a 16px gap.

P2 footer, 'click to set a waypoint' and 'surveyed 2%': Use 16px for the legend, with 32px between items. Shorten the hint to 'waypoint' with a mouse-click glyph. Make the 'm' chip 28px, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P2 contracts panel: Set the reward at 20px tx-1 and the progress at 16px tx-2. Add a 3px accent tab to the focused row. Align the panel top and bottom with the map frame (160 to 920) and give 16px bottom padding.

rarity-after-backpack-greyscale.verdict: A greyscale rarity-cue test of the backpack. It is a small, dim, mostly empty panel with no hierarchy, a tiny text style and weak rarity readability, so it is nowhere near the 90% centred card with an X that the guide requires.
findings: P0 backpack window, whole card: Make the card 90% of the screen wide (about 1730px by 970px). Put a 40px x button in the top-right corner, with a focus state. Remove the 'b or i to close' text, or move it to a 14px footer legend.

P0 item grid, 8 slots plus 1: Add a 3px bar across the bottom of each tile in the rarity colour. In greyscale this also needs a different cue, so vary the bar length or use 1 to 5 filled 8px segments. Raise the pips to 8px tall with 2px gaps. Make tiles 96px with a 4px gap, and keep the focus tile's 2px lime border.

P1 equipped block and detail pane: Use the 32px title for the selected item's name. Put the stats in a 2-column table of 16px labels in tx-2 and 20px values in tx-1, with 8px row gaps. Make 'use' a real button with a lime fill and 'armor' its label. Pick one spelling ('armour') everywhere.

P1 footer hints 'arrows move  z drop one  drag to tactical belt': Show the hints as key chips (a 24px rounded square with the key letter) followed by one word, in a 14px footer. Show only the keys of the device in use. Cut the 'drag to tactical belt' line.

P1 card interior spacing: Set all section gaps to 24px on the 8px grid. Make the dividers 1px in --ui-line-hi (#4a5257). Raise the card so its bottom edge is 16px or more above the hotbar's tooltip, or dim the hotbar to 40% while the card is open.

rarity-after-stash-greyscale.verdict: This is a competent dark stash card with a clear grid, tabs and close X, and the greyscale test shows rarity still reads through pip counts. Its hierarchy is flat: no hero number, the main action sits in a weak footer, and the right pane is crowded with tiny text.
findings: P1 right pane: gun keys and item wheel (y 640-890): Raise tile height to 72px with 8px padding. Put icons at 32px and labels at 16px. Numerals go at 16px in a corner chip. Drop the 'wheel' filler tile. Leave 24px of space above the footer legend.

P1 header money row (x 1470-1745, y 80-100): Show $900 at 32px f-cond 800 in tx-1. Set xp and stash at 16px tx-2 with 24px gaps between them. Remove the duplicate 'bag $0' here, since 'going up' already shows it.

P1 bottom bar: freebie kit / take: Make the bar a panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Fill the take button with --acc and set its text in --acc-ink at 20px. Make it 160x48, right aligned, 24px from the edge.

P1 stash grid tiles (x 122-1075): Use flat --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line border and a 3px rarity bar at the bottom. Show the item name at 16px under the icon. Make pips 10px with 3px gaps. Add a 2px --acc focus outline with a --ui-raised fill on the focused tile.

P2 tab row (y 130-165) and sort/armory/trophies group: Set the active tab to tx-1 with a 3px --acc underline, and idle tabs to tx-2 at 16px. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between the tabs and the utility group. Shrink the search to 280px so the right-hand links get breathing room.

larger-pips-after-backpack-greyscale.verdict: The backpack is a small dark box floating over a busy raid with the title at the same weight as the rows. It has no hero element and no close X, and the greyscale test shows the pips and rarity cues are still too small to read.
findings: P0 backpack window frame: Make it a 90% card with the --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) behind it and a 32px x button in the top-right corner. Replace the 'b or i to close' text with the x. Keep the card clear of the hotbar, with 24px between them.

P0 item grid and pips: Draw a 3px rarity bar across the bottom of each tile and put a 16px count in the top-right corner. Show the focused tile with a 2px --acc border on a --ui-raised fill. Make the tiles 96px. Add empty slot outlines so the grid reads as 8 by 2.
P1 hierarchy: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Make the selected item name 32px and the price a single 20px tx-1 figure. Reduce the equipped row to a quiet tx-2 label with 16px stats.

P1 stat lines: Lay the stats out as label and value pairs in a grid, with 16px tx-2 labels above 20px tx-1 values and 16px row spacing. Keep the icon 8px clear of the text. Fix the spelling to 'armour'.
P1 key hints: Show keycap chips (z, f) with 16px labels in a footer row of 72px. Drop 'drag to tactical belt' and show the pad glyph when a pad is in use.

shape-cues-after-minimap-greyscale.verdict: The greyscale shape-cue test mostly works: the minimap marks, rarity pips and the pistol slot all stay readable without colour. But the HUD has five or more clashing panel styles and mixed type sizes, and the top-right corner and the bottom-left bars are cluttered.
findings: P1 top-right career block, minimap, run info and extraction chip: Put all four in one column of the same width (about 300px). Give each the same panel treatment: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, 8px gap. Make the career rows a vertical list of 20px label and value pairs. Align the extraction chip to the same left and right edges.

P1 hierarchy across the HUD: Make hp the bigger of the two bars (28px high, 20px bold label). Make stamina a 10px thin bar with no inside label. Keep the ammo as the hero. Cut the timer to 32px so it stays secondary.

P1 current pillager bots list (top-left), with a clipped ghost panel beneath it: Remove or fix the orphaned panel behind the list. Give the list 16px padding and the same 4px radius as other panels. Align it to the same 48px left margin as the standing chip and toasts. Use 16px minimum text with a 20px name column.

P1 toasts and tags: codex entry, contract item nearby, running slowly, concealed · in cover, extraction c available: Define one chip: 32px high, 4px radius, 12px horizontal padding, 16px label, an optional 3px left accent bar. Use it for all five. Put status chips (running, concealed) in a fixed row above the hp bar instead of floating or right-anchored. Drop the double-dot separators.

P2 bottom hotbar: Raise the slot numbers to 16px. Drop empty-slot silhouettes to about 25% opacity and remove the empty bar. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border and a raised fill. Leave 8px between the hint line and the slots, or move the hint above at 16px.

shape-cues-after-minimap-states-greyscal.verdict: In greyscale the minimap shapes do separate the marker types, but the HUD as a whole is crowded, uses too many type sizes, and its panels are inconsistent, so a player would not call it polished.
findings: P0 top-left, pillager bots leaderboard over extraction toasts: Give the leaderboard its own slot with a 16px gap below it. Stack world-anchored toasts so they never draw under a HUD panel, or hide the toast while the panel covers it. Remove the duplicate extraction text.

P1 top-right column: cash/stash card, minimap, run info: Use one panel component: 90% --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Use 8px gaps between panels and a 5% safe margin from the edge. Frame the minimap with the same border and keep it fully inside the screen.

P1 HUD-wide type: Use five sizes only: 56 hero, 32, 20, 16 minimum, 14 footer. Raise all read text to at least 16px. Make the 5:00 timer the hero at 56px f-cond 800. Drop 'hp 100' to 32px and keep the ammo number as the second hero, or merge the two.

P1 center-top, '5:00' + 'extract 30m' pill: Put the timer at 56px with a 2px dark outline or inside the standard panel. Use the standard panel fill and 4px radius for the pill, and make the direction arrow at least 16px.
P1 minimap markers: Keep at most 5 shape classes, each at least 14px, with a 2px dark outline halo. Make the extraction rings a 2px solid stroke in white, and set the letters at 16px.

p1-greyscale.verdict: A greyscale raid HUD that reads fine as a test of shape cues, but the corners compete with each other, the type sizes drift, and there is no single hot accent, so it still looks like an amateur HUD.
findings: P1 top-right stack (cash/xp/stash/backpack, run info, contracts): Make the stack one panel width with 24px padding. Put contracts on single-line rows with a 16px minimum. Drop the repeated backpack value. Leave the cash number at tx-1 600 and everything else tx-2. Keep a 24px margin from the screen edge.

P1 ammo block bottom-right (12 / 24): Use panel fill #16191b at 90% with a 1px #4a5257 border and a 3px --acc tab on the left. Set 12 at 56px/800 and /24 at 20px tx-2. Put the backpack line on a single 16px baseline in tx-2, aligned to the panel's 24px padding.

P1 hotbar bottom-centre: Draw the selected slot with a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Render empty slots at 40% opacity with the silhouettes removed. Raise the tooltip to 16px with 8px padding and a panel behind it, and move 'fire' and 'use' to key-hint chips.

P1 HUD copy and messages (contract item nearby ×2, codex entry, extract 152m): Remove one of the two and drop the 'gold glow marks the box' clause. Use one toast component: --ui-panel fill, 1px border, a 16px label, and a 24px icon slot. Stack toasts at a 24px margin from the left edge.

P2 bottom-left vitals (standing, stamina, hp 100): Use equal 12px bars. Put the labels above the bars at 16px/600. Show hp at 32px in tx-1 on the left. Give the 'standing' chip the toast component styling.

p2-greyscale.verdict: A greyscale raid HUD with a clear hero ammo number and a readable hotbar, but the HUD is made of many unrelated panel styles, mixed type sizes and capital letters, and it is crowded at every corner.
findings: P0 top-right career block and run info: Rebuild as one vertical list with equal rows, 16px minimum labels and 24px padding. Cut contracts to short fragments such as 'servo actuator 0/2', each on one line. Use one panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 hotbar, hp and stamina bars, ammo panel: Use one panel recipe with a 4px radius and the same border. Make the ammo number 56px weight 800 and the gun name 20px tx-2. Move the backpack line out of the ammo panel. Hide empty slots 4-0 at 30% opacity, or show only the slot number.

P1 top-left 'current pillager bots 2' card and 'f1 controls': Change the header to 'pillagers' at 16px +.04em tx-2. Highlight the 'you' row with a 3px --acc left bar. Move 'f1 controls' to the footer legend at 14px with no box. Set the panel fill to 90% --ui-panel.

P1 top-centre timer and extract chip: Make the timer 56px weight 800 with a 90% --ui-void backing. Put the extract distance at 16px in --extract teal, attached to the timer with 8px spacing. Make the direction arrow 16px.

P1 player name labels and pickup toasts: Set all of these to 16px minimum. Use one tag style: --ui-panel fill, 1px border, 8px padding. Separate the two player names, with one nameplate per player and a P1/P2 tint only after the owner picks the colours.

94-firefight-rung-0.verdict: The raid HUD has a good hero ammo number and a clean hotbar, but the screen is fragmented. Six panel styles, mixed sizes and colours, small low-contrast text and stacked popups make it read as a template rather than one system.
findings: P0 top-left 'current pillager bots' panel, top-right cash/run-info panels, bottom-left 'codex entry' toast: Use one panel P: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Use a 3px lime tab on the left edge only for the star panel (ammo). Use the same header style everywhere: 16px f-cond 600, tx-2.

P0 top-right run info / contracts block: Cut each objective to a short label plus a right-aligned count, for example 'haul $1,600  0/1'. Use one left edge at 16px padding. Put the count in tx-1 and the label in tx-2. Remove the 'dawn clear' line or fold it into the header.

P1 hotbar plus 'scav pistol / fire / use' hint strip and 'location revealed' toast above it: Put the toast on its own line 16px above the hint strip, centred, 20px text, with 8px between the layers. Raise slot numbers to 16px. Dim empty-slot icons to 25%. Keep the selected slot's lime border as the only bright element.

P1 ammo panel, bottom right: Align all three text rows to one right edge with 16px padding. Move the weapon name above the number in tx-2 16px. Remove the duplicate backpack value. Match the panel height to the hotbar, 72px. Anchor the lime tab at 36px wide, flush left.

P1 hp / stamina bars, bottom left: Put both bars on one panel P. Use a dark empty-track fill (--ui-raised) and an --ok fill for hp. Drop the label to 16px at the bar's left, with the number at 20px. Fold 'standing' into a 16px tx-2 label above the bars. Give stamina a neutral tx-2 fill.

94-firefight-rung-2.verdict: A readable in-raid HUD with a good hotbar and ammo block, but the corners are cluttered with mismatched panels, a clipped contract list and amber-on-orange text that loses contrast.
findings: P1 top-right run info and contracts panel: Use one row per contract: a 16px tx-2 label on the left and the count right-aligned in tx-1. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between contracts and a 16px gap between the cash panel and run info. Make the header 16px, tx-2, +.04em, so the rows read first.

P1 HUD panels, all four corners: Apply one panel spec: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Use the same 14-16px type for every header, and show the chevron on every collapsible panel or on none.

P1 amber text on warm terrain: 'concealed · in cover', pillager names, 'current pillager bots 3': Put status chips on --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px border. Use tx-1 for the text, with a 3px --warn bar on the left as the only amber. Use tx-1 for panel headers and keep lime or amber for focus only.

P1 bottom-left hp, stamina and standing: Use 16px tx-1 labels inside or beside the bars. Use one 56px hero number only where it matters, the ammo, and keep hp at 32px. Make the bars 12px high, with the damage segment in --danger at 60%. Align 'standing' flush to the bar's left edge, 8px above it.
P2 bottom-right ammo block: Set the secondary lines to 16px --tx-2 with 4.5:1 contrast. Move the lime tab to the left edge at full height, or remove it. Use 24px padding on all sides.

96-easy-after-map-p1.verdict: The question card is now a real modal with a lime yes button, an outlined no button and a neutral border, but it is still a floating box over a fully lit HUD, with a dead title row and an unlabeled countdown.
findings: P1 whole screen, behind the card: Add a full-screen rgba(6,7,8,.80) scrim under the card. Alternatively, hide the controls panel and run info panel while the question is open. The card should be the only bright element.
P1 controls panel, bottom centre (x 493-900, y 703-870): Hide it while the card is open. Outside the card, fold it to one 16px line ('f1 controls'), per the owner's ruling that it starts folded.

P1 card border and edges, x 587-1333, y 262-515: Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make the countdown a full-width 3px bar with a --ui-line track and a lime fill that drains. Remove the orphan tick.

P1 title row, 'want easy mode?' (x 623, y 318): Set the title to 32px tx-1 f-cond 700 and make it the only bold line. Replace '12' with 'auto no in 12s' at 16px tx-2, or with the draining bar. Use 32px top padding and 24px between the title and the buttons.

P1 yes / no buttons (y 398-478): Put 'y' and 'n' in 1px-bordered 4px-radius key caps inside each button. Give the focused button a 2px --acc-hover outer ring. Raise the no border to --ui-line-hi and use tx-1 for its text. Show the pad glyph (a / b) when a pad is in use.

96-easy-after-map-p2.verdict: The easy-mode question is a small, flat, translucent box dropped mid-raid over a busy map, with a tiny prompt that is hard to read and no real choice buttons, so it looks like a debug overlay and not a designed card.
findings: P0 easy mode card, centre (618,263 to 1302,411): Fill it with solid #16191b at 95% or more, use a 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius and 24px padding. Dim the whole screen behind it with --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.8). Cut the box to about 560x220 and centre it.

P0 answer line 'y yes · n no · 12': Add two 20px buttons side by side, 160x48 each. 'yes' gets the lime #e6ff3d fill with #11150a text. 'no' gets a 1px #4a5257 outline. Put the key or pad glyph inside each button ('y' / 'n' on keyboard, 'a' / 'b' on pad). Show the countdown as a 16px ring or number on the right, labelled for example '12s'.

P1 title 'want easy mode?': Set the title to 32px tx-1 #efe9dc, f-cond 700, left aligned at the 24px padding. Add one 16px tx-2 line such as 'more hp, slower foes' only if the real effect is short. Drop the teal border and use #4a5257.

P1 card placement and timing, centre of the live raid: Hide the controls cheat sheet and run info while the card is open. Dim the world by 60 to 80 percent. Keep only the hp and ammo bars at their normal size.

P1 controls cheat sheet, bottom-left (492,696 to 902,866): Use 16px minimum, key column tx-1 and action column tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, and a solid #16191b panel with 24px padding. Remove the duplicate lmb row or label one 'lmb (item)'. Align the rows on a 24px baseline grid.

96-initials-in-raid-p2.verdict: The card no longer overlaps the controls legend. It now sits cleanly above the scene with a lime focus letter, a left-aligned title and a corner countdown, but it is still a plain dark box with no scrim, and the HUD stays at full brightness around it.
findings: P1 scene behind the card and HUD (whole screen): Draw a full-screen rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer behind the card, or at minimum dim the HUD to 40% while it is open. Hide the controls legend (x 492-902, y 702-872) while the card is open.
P1 card shape and edge (556-1364 x 261-555): Use a --ui-panel #16191b fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi #4a5257 border and a 4px radius. Make the lime tick a full 3px top bar across the card or remove it.
P1 hint line (y ~522): Cut it to two short key hints, 'enter done' and 'backspace back', as tx-2 16px labels. Give the keys small pill glyphs. Centre it 24px under the letter underlines (y 452).

P1 title 'tonight's best · enter initials' (592, 318): Centre the title block. Use 'tonight's best' at 32px f-cond 700 tx-1, with 'enter initials' on its own line at 16px tx-2. Render the countdown as a 32px --acc number or a thin progress bar along the card's bottom edge.

P2 letter row (830-1090 x 395-455): Set the letters to 56px f-cond 800 and use 24px gaps. Give the active slot a 64x72 --ui-raised tile with a 3px lime underline, and keep the idle underlines at --ui-line-hi.

96-initials-solo-run-over.verdict: A clean, quiet run-over card with a clear hero number and a live prompt, but the type is too small for a couch, the initials block fights the main action, and the card sits small in an unfinished-looking dim scene.
findings: P1 initials block (a a a) and its hint line: Make the letters 40px f-cond 700 with 16px gaps. Use --acc for the active letter and underline, and tx-1 for the rest. Cut the hint to the pad or key glyphs only ('▲▼  enter') at 16px --tx-2.
P1 press any key prompt: Show 'enter  done' as the one prompt, 24px --acc, left-aligned under the initials. Drop the competing 'press any key' text, or show it only once the initials are done.

P1 label and stat text (score, kills, extractions, deaths, tonight's best): Set labels to 16px with +.04em tracking in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Set stat numbers to 32px f-cond 700. Set 'extracted x2' to 20px --tx-1.

P1 stats row (9 / 1 / 0): Use a 3-column grid with 24px gutters and left-align each column to the 24px card padding. Put 'tonight's best' in 16px --tx-1 with a 1px --ui-line rule above it, and leave 24px between sections.

P2 card overall and the title 'run over': Make the title 32px f-cond 700 and the score 56px f-cond 800. Change the top tab from a 36px lime tick to a 3px left-edge accent bar the full height of the score block, and tighten the vertical rhythm to an 8px grid.

r3-hub.verdict: The hub reads as a cluttered debug scene: many overlapping circles and a crowd of identical characters bury the stations, and the HUD has no consistent type scale or panel style.
findings: P0 station interaction circles and rings: Draw one 2px ring per station at 25% opacity. Delete the filled discs. Fill and brighten only the nearest station. Remove the stray discs at (1440,280), (960,550) and (480,880).

P0 'enter raid!' label, top centre: Use the same 20px label style as the other stations, with a lime 3px underline or accent tab as the one primary. Drop the '!'. Add a lime ring on the raid station when the player is near it. Keep the label out from behind the pillars.

P1 station name labels: Anchor every label 16px above its station, centred, with 8px by 16px padding, a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Nudge the labels away from walls rather than letting them overlap.
P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' chip under 'the last pour': Replace it with a 16px 'beta' tag in --warn inside the label chip, or remove it. No asterisks.

P1 top-right currency strip ('$900  0 xp  stash $3,750 bag $0'): Make a vertical list on a --ui-panel with a 24px margin from the screen edge. Use 20px for the values and 16px --tx-2 for the labels. Show '$900' as the hero value in lime or --tx-1. Do not use bold in two places.

79-raid-controls-folded-career.verdict: The controls list now sits mid-bottom left and folds to a small 'f1 controls' chip, as the owner ordered. But the unfolded panel is a dense, tiny, dim, ragged four-column block that overlaps the log and sits on the water. The HUD around it is crowded and its type sizes don't follow the five-size scale.
findings: P1 image 2, unfolded controls panel (x 493-900, y 702-872): Raise to 16px f-cond 600 with 24px row pitch. Use tx-1 for keys and tx-2 #aaa498 for actions. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Group into move / combat / items with a 16px gap between groups, and add a 'controls' label at the top left.

P1 image 2, panel position against the left log and the hotbar: Anchor the panel's bottom-left to the same 5% margin as the hp bar (x 24). Put it above the hotbar tag with a 16px gap, and move the log up or stack it above the panel so no rows share a y-band.

P1 image 2, 'run info' contracts list (x 1605-1900, y 90-335): Truncate or widen the card to 360px so each contract fits on one line. Make the headers 'contracts' and 'run goals' 16px tx-2 and the rows 20px tx-1. Right-align the counts in a column and drop 'dawn clear' from the card.

P2 image 1, 'f1 controls' chip (x 491-589, y 842-872): Use the same chip style as 'standing': --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Set 'f1' as a key cap in tx-1 and 'controls' in tx-2. Align its left edge to x 24 so it stacks above 'standing', or keep it centred-left at a fixed margin.
P2 image 2, collapse caret (x 884-898, y 706): Remove the caret. Keep one footer hint, 'f1 hide', at 16px tx-2, right-aligned in the panel's footer row.

80-raid-controls-career-after-f1.verdict: The controls panel is much better: it has key caps, grouped sections and a tidy two-column layout. The raid HUD around it is still crowded, with the run-info card, the left log and the panel's position all unresolved.
findings: P1 run info card, x 1605-1900, y 90-335: Drop 'dawn clear'. Set the 'contracts' and 'run goals' headers to 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with 16px space above. Set the rows to 20px tx-1. Right-align the counts in a column at x 1880. Widen the card to 360px.

P1 controls panel, x 493-757, y 608-872: Anchor the panel's left edge at x 24 and its bottom edge 16px above the 'standing' chip (about y 930). Make the row pitch 24px. Rename the 'move' section header to 'movement', or merge it so it is not a duplicate of the 'move' row.

P1 controls panel text, section labels and action words: Set labels to 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Set key caps to 16px tx-1 on --ui-raised with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set action words to 16px tx-1 or tx-2. Raise the panel padding to 16px.

P1 left log, x 15-315, y 692-802: Move the whole log up above the panel and cap it at 3 rows. Give every row the same 16px label size, one left bar colour and one fill. Make 'running slowly' match the others or drop it.
P2 world prompt chips, x 833-1090, y 152-210: Centre both chips under the 'extract 152m' tag at a fixed width of 300px with 8px between them. Keep the order stable between versions.

fog-live-off.verdict: The raid HUD has a strong ammo block and hotbar, but the top-right money strip overprints itself, the controls list sits in the middle of play, and sizes and panel styles drift from one corner to the next.
findings: P0 top-right cash/stash strip: Rebuild it as one vertical 1x1 list (cw-trcol), with each item 20px f-cond, label 16px tx-2 on the left and value tx-1 right-aligned. Use one font size, keep a 16px inset, and don't draw each value twice. Contain it in a panel with 8px padding.

P1 controls list, bottom centre-left (x490-757, y655-920): Collapse it to a single 16px line ('f1 controls') anchored at x=5% from the left, bottom 120px. Open the full list only on F1. Never show it open by default in a career raid.

P1 HUD panels overall (kill list, minimap, run info, controls, ammo): Use one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, header 16px f-cond 600 tx-2. Put the chevron on every collapsible panel in the same place.

P1 left kill list ('current pillager bots'): Show only the live count and the 'you' line, or fold the dead rows into 'x out · 7 dead'. If the rows stay, use a 16px minimum, tx-2 text at 4.5:1 and a 24px row pitch. Drop the off-palette pink, or use --acc only if it means selected.

P1 bottom-left stamina and hp bars: Make hp and stamina the same height (24px) with the label 16px and the value right-aligned inside. Keep hp as the single bold element (56px hero only for ammo). Align the baselines of the bars with the hotbar slot bottoms, and restyle 'standing' as a quiet 16px tx-2 tag.

fog-live-on.verdict: The raid HUD has a readable ammo hero and a clear weapon bar, but the top-right money strip prints overlapping text, the controls card sits open in mid-screen, and the five corner panels use different type sizes, borders and fills.
findings: P0 top-right money strip (cash / xp / stash / bag): Draw each value once in a 2-column list: label at 16px tx-2, value at 20px tx-1 right-aligned, 8px row gap, 16px padding. Drop the duplicated stash and bag entries. Follow the cw-trcol vertical list.
P1 controls card, bottom centre-left (x 490-757): Fold it to a single 'f1 controls' line at 16px at x≈5%, y≈1040 and open it on F1. Keep it open only in the party demo.

P1 all HUD panels (pillager list, money, minimap, run info, controls, ammo): One panel: fill #16191b at 90%, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Title 16px f-cond 600 tx-2; body 20px tx-1 (labels 16px tx-2). Same collapse chevron on every panel.

P1 bottom-left status (standing / stamina / hp 100): Make both bars 12px tall with a #1e2225 track. Put the hp number at 32px, but only 800 weight for the one hero. Set the labels at 16px tx-1 above the bars. Show the posture as plain 16px tx-2 text with no pill.

P1 weapon slot bar: Use only lime for the active slot (3px border) and a 1px line border for the others. Dim the empty slots to 40% and shrink them to icon-only cells. Drop the blue tint and put 'f' in the label. Align the hint line to the bar's left edge at 16px.

fps-screen-rate.verdict: The title screen is clean and the lime 1 player button is the clear first read. Almost none of the earlier advice was applied: the gold gradient wordmark, four equal-weight buttons, the weak saves block, the legend and the top-right buttons are all as before.
findings: P1 pillagers wordmark: Use Barlow Condensed 700 or 800 at 56px (hero), solid --tx-1 (#efe9dc), no gradient and no shadow. Or use real logo art that avoids both gold and lime. Keep a 24px gap to the tagline.

P1 buttons 2 player co-op, 2 player arcade demo, 1 player arcade demo: Keep 1 player (lime) and 2 player co-op as the two main buttons, with 20px text and 48px height. Move the two demos to a 16px --tx-2 text-link row below them, or into a 'demos' group. Drop '(same machine)' or move it to a 16px --tx-2 sub-label. Narrow the column to about 440px.

P1 saves block (label, row, name input, change name, create a new save): Set the 'saves' label at 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking and 24px above it. Selected row: --ui-raised fill, 3px lime left bar, name in --tx-1 at 20px, no full lime outline. Leave 16px between the list and the controls. Make the controls 40px high with equal 8px gaps. Add a 'name' label or placeholder. Make 'create a new save' the quieter text-style action.

P2 top-right go fullscreen and settings: Put both on the 5% margin (96px from the top and right). Use the 4px-radius outline button with 16px f-cond 600 text, 40px height and 24px padding. Give pad focus a 2px lime outline.

P2 bottom key legend and v0.1148: Cut the legend to 'f1 controls', or remove it. Key caps: 16px, --ui-raised fill, 1px --ui-line-hi outline, --tx-1 text. Put v0.1148 at 14px on the same baseline as the legend, at the 96px margin.

fps-screen-rate-control.verdict: The calm column with one lime primary row is solid and readable, but the amber-gradient wordmark, equal-weight demo rows, mixed lime in the save strip and the key-hint legend still make it look assembled rather than designed.
findings: P1 pillagers wordmark: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 #efe9dc at f-cond 800, 56px or larger, with no gradient and no shadow, and leave lime only on the focused row. Or keep it big (about 96px) and flat. Delete the amber fill.

P1 menu stack: 2 player arcade demo and 1 player arcade demo: Keep 1 player and 2 player co-op as 56px primary rows. Make both demos 40px, 16px, --tx-2 text, with no border or a --ui-line border, and put them 24px below co-op. Use a constant 8px gap inside a group.

P1 saves block: Set the 'saves' label to 16px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Give the save row a --ui-line-hi border and --tx-1 name text, with lime only on actual focus. Make the input and both buttons 48px tall with 16px gaps. Put the strip 24px below the save row and align it to the stack's 558px width.

P2 footer key hints (wasd move, mouse aim, lmb fire, e search, f1 controls): Cut the legend to nav hints only (select, back) at 16px --tx-2, or move the raid keys to the controls screen. Set the version to 14px f-body 500 in --tx-2, aligned to the 5% margin (96px left, 54px from the bottom) on the same baseline as the hints.

P2 top-right go fullscreen and settings buttons: Turn 'go fullscreen' into a 48px square icon button. Set labels to 16px/600, and put the pair at right 96px, top 54px with a 16px gap. Move the fps badge to the same 96px / 54px margin or hide it outside debug.

solo-ping-map.verdict: The window frame, title row and contracts list are clean and consistent, but the map still has about 10 repeated 'cache' labels, labels with no plates, tiny map type, and a contracts panel that has no focus row and no hero.
findings: P1 map, cache labels (foreman office, blast freezer, top centre, sump): Draw one cache glyph per cluster with a 16px tx-2 'x3' count and no repeated words. Keep a 12px minimum gap between any two labels and delete the leader lines.

P1 map labels (packing floor, the sump, scrap line, chill row, strongbox, hot ground, the long dock): Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 +.04em on a 4px-padded --ui-void plate at 80%. Use tx-1 for places the player can act on, tx-2 (#aaa498) for static areas, and red or teal only for danger or extract. Drop pure white.

P1 contracts panel rows: Fill the focused row with --ui-raised and a 3px --acc left bar. Set the reward to 20px tx-1 and the count to 16px tx-2. Make the progress bar 4px with --acc filling to the current count. Put the row divider on --ui-line.

P1 map, player marker and waypoint cursor (533,450) and (571,440): Draw the player marker at 40px with a 2px dark outline. Draw the waypoint reticle as a 24px --acc ring. Move 'seal 0%' 24px away from the cursor and set it in 16px tx-2.

P2 header row: 'cold storage', 'sector map', '6pm · clear', close x: Set '6pm · clear' to 16px tx-2. Merge 'sector map' into a 16px tx-2 label with 16px spacing from the title. Give the x a 2px --acc border on focus.

solo-ping-minimap.verdict: The ammo hero and the hotbar read well, but the earlier minimap, type-scale and left-edge advice was mostly not applied, so the HUD still looks like several unrelated widgets.
findings: P1 top-right minimap: Enlarge the markers to 16px with a 2px --ui-void outline. Dim the wall strips to --ui-line-hi at about 60% opacity. Replace 'n' with a 16px tick in the top-left corner. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius to the map frame.
