P1 left panel 'current pillager bots 7': Rename it 'ranks' or 'bots 7' at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Use the same panel style as 'contracts 0/8': --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 40px height. Add a lime 'you #n' on the right. Set the left margin to 48px.

P1 HUD type scale: Use 56px for ammo only. Set the timer, '/ 60' and 'hp 100' all to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1. Set 'compact smg', the key hints, 'f1 controls', the slot numbers and 'b / i backpack' to 16px. Set '4 items $1,560' to 16px in --tx-2.

P1 bottom-left hp bar: Set the bar to 24px tall with a --ui-panel track, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, inset 48px from the left and 48px from the bottom. Put the number in --tx-1 at 20px inside the bar with a 2px --ui-void shadow. Use --ok for the fill.

P2 hotbar and 'f1 controls' chip: Draw the selected slot with a 3px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Draw the empty slots as 1px --ui-line tiles at 72px, 45% opacity. Put the 'f1 controls' chip at x=48 and level with the hotbar at 16px. Move the 'f' badge to the top-right corner of its slot.

solo-ping-world.verdict: The HUD is much calmer than before: the folded bot list and contracts bar, the single sentry plate and the quiet ammo card all read cleanly. The panels, hp bar and slot styling are still not on one recipe, and the 56px hero number and the in-world labels need tuning.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Make the bar 12px high with a 1px --ui-line-hi frame and an --ok fill. Put it 24px above the bottom edge and 48px left of slot 1. Set 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1, inline.

P1 hotbar slots 1–8 and 0: Draw all 8 slots as 100px tiles on a 16px pitch. Use --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. The selected slot gets a 3px --acc border on --ui-raised. Empty slots sit at 40% opacity with no silhouettes. Set numbers at 16px --tx-2.

P1 bottom-right ammo card: Set the margin to 24px right and 24px bottom. Set the gun name to 16px --tx-2. Set the footer line to 16px with at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the minimap card.

P1 in-world labels: 'you · sentry r-46 · 17m' and 'search crate': Show 'sentry r-46' in --tx-1 and '17m' in --tx-2, and drop 'you'. Put the plate 16px above the ring. Set both plates to 16px f-cond 600 on --ui-panel at 85%, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, and 8px by 4px padding.

P2 top-left bot list, top-right contracts bar, and extract pill: Use one margin of 24px (48px at 5% safe area) for the bot list, minimap and contracts. Give the extract pill 8px by 16px padding, --ui-panel fill and a 1px --extract border. Put the clock on the same plate or move it into the pill.

p1-legacy.verdict: The roster fold and the ammo card are better, but the hp bar is still a bare strip, the hotbar still shows five dim silhouettes, and the top-left corner stacks four separate elements.
findings: P1 bottom-left hp bar 'hp 100': Put it in a 4px-radius --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Place the card 24px from the left and bottom edges. Inside it, use a 20px bar with a --ui-raised track. Set 'hp' as a 16px tx-2 label and '100' as a 20px/700 tx-1 number outside the fill. Turn the fill --warn below 50% and --danger below 25%.

P1 top-left stack: 'keyboard' chip, 'pillager 236m' arrow, roster card, and the 'pillager' tag with its green bar: Anchor everything to one 24px left margin. Draw the roster at a fixed 360px wide. Leave 16px between the roster, the tag and the chip. Move the 236m direction arrow to the screen edge, away from the 'keyboard' chip. Delete the duplicate tag bar, or merge it into the hp card.

P1 roster card 'current pillager bots 1': Fold it by default to the single line '0 out · 2 dead' with the chevron. When open, use 16px/600 rows on a 24px pitch, put dead rows at 40% opacity, and delete the '- dead' text. Align the money column to one right edge with tabular numerals.

P2 hotbar slots 3 and 5 to 0: Remove the silhouettes from empty slots. Show only a 16px tx-2 number with a 1px --ui-line border at 50% opacity. Keep the 2px lime border on the active slot only. Give the owned rifle in slot 4 a --ui-line-hi border instead of a blue fill. Make the slot numbers 16px.

P2 bottom-right ammo card: Set the footer in 16px/600 f-cond. Add a 1px --ui-line divider above it and 16px card padding. Colour '$1,220' tx-1 and keep '3 items' in tx-2. Draw 'b / i' as a key chip like 'f1'.

120d-host-lt-smooth.verdict: The raid HUD is now cleaner: the controls list is gone, the bots list and contracts row are collapsible panels, and the ammo card has a clear hero number. The hp and stamina bars still look unfinished and the corner margins don't match.
findings: P1 hp and stamina bars, bottom-left: Put both bars in one --ui-panel card (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border) at a 24px margin. Make the bars 16px tall with a 16px f-cond label on the left and the value on the right in --tx-1. Use --ok for hp and a muted --extract for stamina, and align the card's bottom edge with the hotbar.

P1 screen margins, all four corners: Use a 24px safe margin (5% of screen is preferred) for every corner card. Anchor the bots card at top:24px, left:24px. Anchor the minimap at top:24px, right:24px. Anchor the ammo card at bottom:24px, right:24px. Anchor the hp and stamina card at bottom:24px, left:24px.

P1 minimap, top-right: Crop it to a 240px square with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the icons at least 12px. Widen the contracts row to match, at 16px --tx-2, on the same 24px margin.

P1 bots list, top-left: Make the rows 24px with 16px text. Show 'you' in --acc and the other names in --tx-1 (purple only if it is a rarity). Fold the list to one line ('current pillager bots 7') by default and open it on demand, at the 24px margin.

P2 timer and extract chip, top-centre: Put the timer and extract row in one centred --ui-panel card (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border), with the arrow on the extract row inside the card. Keep the timer in --tx-1 and the extract text in --extract.

120d-host-rt-smooth.verdict: The HUD is a little tidier and reads fine, but the earlier fixes mostly weren't applied. The edge margins are still ragged, the timer and extract pill are still tiny, and the cards still use different panel styles.
findings: P1 top-centre clock and extract pill: Make 'extract 136m' 40px f-cond 800 in --extract, with no chip fill. Shrink the clock to a 16px --tx-2 tag beside it. Remove the sun icon, or shrink it to a 16px glyph attached to the clock. Attach the arrow to the text or drop it.

P1 left roster, bottom-left bars, bottom-right weapon card and minimap: Use one 54px margin for every HUD block. Fill every panel with --ui-panel, give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the roster at x=54, the bars at x=54 with the bottom at y=1026, and the weapon card at right and bottom 54px.

P1 roster 'current pillager bots 7' (top-left): Cut to the top 3 plus 'you'. Use 16px f-cond 600 and 20px row height. Mark 'you' with a 3px --acc bar and tx-1 text, and set the other rows in --tx-2. Turn the purple name into --tx-1. Shorten the heading to 'bots 7'.

P1 hp and stamina bars (bottom-left): Make both bars 20px tall with an 8px gap, inset to x=54. Put 16px f-cond 600 labels above each bar, with the value right-aligned. Keep hp in --ok, and make stamina --tx-2 at a dim fill. Remove the oversized hp text.

P1 hotbar slots 1-9: Give the selected slot a 2px #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised fill. Raise idle icons to 55% opacity. Set slot numbers to 14px minimum. Show 'rb' on slots 1 and 9 only, or on none. Align the hotbar bottom to y=1026.

p2-lt-smooth.verdict: The HUD is now clean and the controls card is gone, but the bot list, the clipped bars, the hotbar and the ammo card still ignore the style guide and fight for attention.
findings: P1 top-left 'current pillager bots 7' list: Fold it to one 16px tx-2 line, 'bots 7', and open it on a key. If it stays open, use 16px tx-1 names, tx-2 $ values and 24px rows, and make the purple name tx-1. Set the left edge to 96px and the top to 48px.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre: Give slot 7 a 2px --acc border on a --ui-raised fill and remove the gold fill. Give idle slots a 1px --ui-line-hi border with the icon at 50%. Set the numerals to 14px tx-2. Remove the 'rb' chip, or move it to a 16px hint beside the bar.

P1 stamina and hp bars, bottom-left: Make both bars 12px tall and 360px wide, with the left edge at 96px and the bottom at 48px. Put 16px tx-2 labels above them. Show the hp number as the one 32px tx-1 hero, right-aligned. Use --ok for the hp fill and tx-2 at 40% for the stamina fill, on a --ui-line track.

P1 ammo card, bottom-right: Set the right and bottom margins to 48px with 16px padding. Show 'longshot' alone at 20px and put '4x' in a 16px tag. Show 4 / 50 at the 56px hero. Set 'view backpack' and the item count at 16px tx-2. Remove the duplicate $3,510.
P2 alert banner, left at y=789: Move it to the top-centre banner position, as the one-place rule says. Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' at 20px in --warn. Delete the gold glow clause.

p2-rt-smooth.verdict: The controls card is gone and the feed line is now short and shown once, but the bots list, bar, ammo card and minimap each still use a different panel, and the edge insets are tiny.
findings: P1 bots list (x 8-368, y 143-315): Fold it by default to one 16px header row, 'pillager bots 7' (drop 'current'), with a chevron. When open, use 16px rows on a 24px pitch, a 1px #2e3337 divider between rows, 'you' in --acc, and balances in --tx-2. Put it at x=16, y=16.

P1 weapon bar (x 550-1558, y 950-1060): Selected slot: 2px #e6ff3d border over a --ui-raised fill. Idle icons at 60% opacity. Slot numbers 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Show the 'rb' hint on none of the slots, or on every slot that has one, as a 16px chip.

P1 panel system: bots list, minimap, contracts bar, ammo card, weapon bar, feed line: Use one panel for all of them: fill #16191b at 0.92 alpha, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Body text 16px minimum and 20px for names. Use a 3px left bar only where the colour carries meaning (--warn on the feed line).

P1 ammo card (x 1642-1910, y 902-1052): Inset the card 32px from the screen edge. Set the footers to 16px in --tx-2 with 16px padding. Make the weapon name 20px --tx-1 and left-align it with the footers. Keep the 56px hero, with the '4' in --tx-1 and the '/ 50' in --tx-2.

P1 top-right minimap and contracts bar (x 1602-1902, y 18-365): Shrink the minimap to about 240x240 and inset it 32px. Give it a 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Move the chevron out of the map into a 32px header row 'contracts 0/8' with 16px text and a 16px --tx-2 chevron. Both blocks get the same fill.

downcuts-host-easy.verdict: The downed card is clear: the big timer is the focal point and the lime [f] prompt is readable. But the HUD around it is cluttered and inconsistent: stray status chips, mixed type scales, a tiny bar label, a purple zone name, and a down-state bar that is hard to read.
findings: P1 downed card, top bar and timer bar: Keep one bar. Either drop the grey bar or merge it with the skill-check row. Label the skill-check bar with a 16px tx-2 word, remove the stray 4px red tick at the card corner, and align the card's inner padding to 24px on all sides.

P1 bottom-left status row (down, eye, leaf icon, concealed, in cover): Remove the 'down' chip, since the card already says it. Use one chip style (4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, 1px --ui-line-hi border). Reserve colour for the one chip that matters (danger or warn) and set the others in tx-2.

P1 hp 0 bar (bottom-left): Set one 5% left margin, about 48px, for the chips and the hp bar. Give the bar a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel and show an empty-state tick or danger-red outline so it reads as 'empty'. Keep the number at 32px.

P1 top-left 'current pillager bots' panel: Drop the repeated '- dead' column and show names in tx-2 with one 'dead' tag at 16px. Make the title tx-2 at 16px and 'you' tx-1 at 20px. Move the panel to the 48px margin, and use the same 4px radius and border as the other cards.

P2 weapon slots (bottom centre): Give slot 1 a lime 2px border as the selected one. Give slot 3 a neutral 1px --ui-line-hi border. Raise the empty slots' contrast so the icons stay at about 40% opacity and the digits at 16px tx-2.

downcuts-joined-kid-easy.verdict: the down card gets the eye first, which is right, but it is a small flat box with a clipped red tab and a stray timing bar. The HUD around it uses mixed panel styles, tiny text and several competing accents, so it reads as unfinished.
findings: P1 down card, top edge (x720-1200, y423): Delete the red sliver or turn it into a full-width 3px --danger top bar. Put the skill-check bar directly under the timer. Use 32px 'down' in --danger, a 56px/800 timer, 24px padding, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius.

P1 bottom-left status chips (y945-980: down, concealed, in cover, two icon discs): Remove the 'down' chip because the card already says it. Use one chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px label, 4px radius, 8px gap. Colour only the glyph. Merge 'concealed' and 'in cover' into one stealth state.

P1 'hp 0' bar (x25-430, y1035-1068): Show the empty state with a --danger outline and a 3px --danger segment. Set the label to 20px --tx-1. Make the bar the same width as the status row, aligned to the same 5% margin.

P1 top-left roster panel (x8-368, y143-260): Collapse it to a one-line 'squad 0/3' that expands on a key. If it stays open, use 16px rows, --tx-2 for dead players, no dashes, and drop the footer sentence. Put it on the 5% margin with the same panel token as the other cards.

P2 HUD corners (contracts 0/8 top-right, c 152m chip right, 'extract 152m' top-centre): Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' chip and keep only the top-centre extract line. Style contracts with the same panel token as the roster. Put the map label in --tx-1 or --tx-2 at 16px, not purple.

p1-reload.verdict: The reload prompt is now a clear lime key cap on a dark chip, but the HUD panels still don't match each other and the bottom row is crowded and uneven.
findings: P1 top-left bots panel (x8-367,y143-260), top-right contracts (x1603-1900,y18-54), ammo panel (x1643-1910,y903-1062): Give all three panels --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Use a 16px f-cond 600 title and 16px --tx-2 rows. Drop the '0' after the title and the 'dead' suffix. Add a 3px amber bar on the 'you' row. Put the ammo footer on one 16px line with a 1px --ui-line divider above it.

P1 hp bar, x24-430,y1035-1068: Make the bar 12px high in --ok on a --ui-line track. Set '100' to 20px f-cond 600 above or beside the bar. Move the left edge to 48px and align the baseline with the hotbar bottom (y≈1058).

P1 hotbar, x550-1558,y950-1062: Mark only the equipped slot with a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Remove the amber border and the blue fill. Set slot numbers and counts to 16px --tx-2. Dim unowned slots to 50% opacity.
P2 reload prompt chip, x946-1038,y484-511: Use 20px f-cond 700 text and a 1px --acc border on a --ui-panel fill. Move it 32px above the head. Give it an --m-in bounce on appear.

P2 world labels 'chill row' / 'the forge' (x900-1015,y160-205) and 'p1' tag (x940-980,y612-642): Set 'chill row' to 16px --tx-1 at +.04em with a 60% black text shadow. Make 'the forge' --tx-2. Make the p1 tag a 16px label on a --ui-panel chip with a 2px amber bottom bar rather than a solid fill.

p1-search-after-reload.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the earlier corner-panel advice was mostly not followed: the hp bar is still a bare green slab, the roster sits off the grid, and the weapon bar's gold border and selection are still muddled.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left (24-430, 1035-1067): Rebuild it as a 320x40 --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Inside it, put a 12px --ok fill bar (--danger below 40%). Set '100' at 20px f-cond 700 in tx-1 and 'hp' at 16px in tx-2. Place it at x=48, with its bottom at 1032 (48px margin).

P1 top-left roster panel (8-367, 143-260): Move it to x=48, y=48. Rename the header 'raiders' at 16px. Put 'dead' in its own right-hand column in --danger at 16px. Set the rows to 16px with 8px gaps, 'you' in tx-1 and the others in tx-2. Delete the footer line. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 85% --ui-panel.

P1 HUD corners overall: Use one HUD panel token: --ui-panel at 85%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, and a 48px margin on all four corners. Align the contracts and ammo panels' outer edges to x=1872, and the hp and roster panels' outer edges to x=48.

P1 weapon bar (549-1558, 951-1060): Mark only the equipped slot, with a 2px --acc border and --ui-raised fill. Remove the gold border from slot 1 and the blue tint from slot 3, which holds the rifle but is not equipped. Raise the slot numbers to 16px tx-2. Lift the bar to a 24px gap from the bottom.

P2 ammo card (1643-1910, 903-1052): Set the footer to 16px tx-2. Add a 24x24 key cap for the backpack key before 'view backpack'. Move 'auto rifle' to 16px tx-2 and align it on the left edge with the footer text. Move the card to a 48px margin.

p2-reload.verdict: The reload prompt is now a proper lime-capped chip above the player and reads clearly, but the HUD around it is still inconsistent: the ammo count is red and mismatched, the hotbar has two competing highlights, the hp bar is oversized, and the contracts and bots panels differ.
findings: P1 hotbar, x548-1558, y950-1060: Use one active rule: a 3px --acc border on the equipped slot with a --ui-raised fill. Every other slot gets a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Raise idle icons to opacity 0.6 or more and slot numbers to 16px --tx-2. Drop the blue fill and the amber border. Make the 'rb' tag 16px or move it out of the slot.

P1 ammo block, x1642-1910, y903-1052: Use --tx-1 for the count and turn it --danger only at 25% ammo or less. Set '/ 60' to 32px --tx-2. Set the footer lines to 16px --tx-2 with 16px padding. Align the panel's bottom edge to the hotbar's (y1060) and give it a 4px radius.

P1 hp bar, x24-430, y1035-1068: Shrink the bar to 240x20px with a --ok fill on a --ui-void track. Set the 'hp 100' label to 20px f-cond 700 in --tx-1, placed beside the bar rather than inside it. Inset the group 48px from the left and 32px from the bottom.

P2 bots panel, x8-367, y143-260: Use 16px rows with a 16px header in --tx-1. Show the status as a small --danger glyph instead of the word 'dead'. Pad the panel 16px, set the radius to 4px and inset it 48px from the left.
P2 contracts 0/8, x1602-1900, y18-55: Use the --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius on all three. Set the label to 16px f-cond 600. Align it to the 48px right margin.

p2-search-after-reload.verdict: The in-raid HUD is readable and the 25/37 ammo number leads, but none of the earlier advice was applied: the hud still has no shared margin, three competing highlights on the weapon bar, and mixed colour roles.
findings: P1 weapon bar, bottom-centre (x550-1558, y950-1062): Mark only the equipped slot, with a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Give every other slot a 1px --ui-line border. Raise idle icon opacity to about 60%. Set the slot numbers to 16px tx-2.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1067): Make the bar 8px thick with a --ok fill that turns --danger below 30%, on a 1px --ui-line-hi track. Put 'hp 100' above it at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Place the block at x 96, bottom 54.

P1 HUD margins: keyboard chip (x10-105, y8-31), roster panel (x8-367, y143-260), contracts (x1602-1900, y18-54), ammo panel (x1642-1910): Put all corner elements on the 5% margin: left 96, top 54, right 96, bottom 54. Use a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border on every panel and chip.

P1 roster panel (x8-367, y143-260): Set the rows at 16px, right-align the amounts, and colour 'dead' --danger. Make the header 16px tx-2 and the 'you' row tx-1 at weight 700. Anchor the panel at x 96, y 54 and move the chip into the same stack.

P1 colour roles: extraction pill (x893-1028, y47-73), contract toast (x15-410, y776-802), 'the forge' label (x949-1010, y185-202), 'x search cache' chip, p2 tag (x940-980, y612-642): Keep teal only for extraction. Make world labels tx-1 at 16px f-cond 600. Use --warn only for the contract toast bar. Give the p2 tag a 1px cyan border with tx-1 text. Set 'chill row' in 16px f-cond with +.04em tracking.

120g-host-extracted.verdict: A clean, well-aligned how-to-play card with a clear title, tidy key-cap table and a visible lime prompt, but it is held back by a ghosted underlay that shows through the scrim, a stray lime bar on the card edge, and a redundant close button on a walk-up screen.
findings: P1 scrim behind the card (header area around y=200-230 and the middle y=380-400): Make the card fill opaque #16191b. Raise the scrim to rgba(6,7,8,.80) and blur the layer behind it, or hide the underlying HUD prompt layer while this card is open.

P1 HUD behind the card (team score, extraction tag, player 2 bar, hp/armour, weapon slots, riot scattergun 7/42): Darken to scrim .80 plus a 6px blur. Drop the lime join-your-team line while the card is open, or fold it into the card footer. Only one lime prompt should be on screen.

P2 card top-left (x=574-610, y=175): Either remove it, or make it a full-width 3px lime top bar on the card, or align it exactly to the title's left edge, inset 0, 32px wide, 3px high, like the other windows.

P2 close x button (x=1298-1346, y=192-240): If the x is standard for every window card, keep it but enlarge the glyph to 20px and use --ui-line-hi #4a5257 for the border. If this walk-up screen is any-key-only, remove it.
P2 column headers 'keyboard' / 'controller' (y=278): Use 16px f-cond 600, +.04em, color --tx-2 #aaa498. Tighten the gap to the rule to 8px.

120g-partner-boarding.verdict: The raid HUD has too many competing banners stacked in the top centre and the middle, and it breaks the one-place-per-line rule. The overlapping name tag and a stray 'a' in the extract line show it is unfinished.
findings: P0 centre of screen, under the player ring: Draw only one label at a time. Hide the cache label while a name tag sits within 120px of it. Give the tag a 4px radius --ui-panel plate with 8px padding. Put the cache label on its own line at least 24px below the tag.

P0 'extract in progress! a 26s left' line: Remove the stray token. Write it as 'extracting 26s' in 56px f-cond 800 --extract (the hero size, once per screen). Put it on an --ui-panel plate at 80% opacity with 8px padding. Drop the 'hold [x] to extract' banner while extraction is running. Delete the duplicate lines.

P1 top-centre stack: team score, extraction 3m chip, teal arrow, siege incoming: Make one 320px column with consistent 8px gaps. Give the score panel, the chip and the banner the same width and a 4px radius. Move the extraction arrow into the chip. Put the siege banner 24px below the column and draw it in --danger with no outer glow.

P1 'hold [x] to extract' banner: Use 32px f-cond 700 text on an --ui-panel plate with a 3px --extract bar on the left. Show the key as a 24px keycap chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Hold the scale back for the extraction hero number only.

P1 bottom-left: f1 controls, armour 60, hp 100 bars: Give armour and hp one shared height of 24px, 8px apart, with 16px f-cond 600 labels. Put the hp fill in --ok and the armour fill in a desaturated blue. Align the f1 chip's left edge to the bar edge at x=24 and set it 16px above the armour bar.

j132-p1-partner-shot.verdict: The hud is readable and has one clear hero number, the ammo count. The edges are still ragged: the score panel sits flush to the top, the damage number overlaps the enemy tag, and the loose chips share no margin or panel style.
findings: P1 top-centre score panel (x 808-1110, y 0-106): Move the panel to y=24. Set padding to 16px, radius to 4px and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the sub-lines 16px in --tx-2. Place the chip 8px below the panel and move the sun icon outside the right padding.

P1 enemy tag over the crawler (x 730-830, y 408-495): Float the damage number 24px above the tag, or hide it while the tag shows. Put the '!' 8px above the tag, inside the same group. Leave 8px of clearance between the tag and the sprite.

P1 'goals 0/3' dropdown (x 1603-1900, y 22-65) vs the 'c 126m' chip (x 1745-1885, y 455-495): Use the --ui-panel fill and a 4px radius on the dropdown. Set its right margin to 96px (5%) and align its top to y=24 with the score panel. Remove the duplicate 'c 126m' chip, or move it into the dropdown. Keep the arrow, but only at the screen edge.

P1 bottom-right ammo card (x 1643-1910, y 868-1018): Inset the card 48px from the right edge. Align its bottom with the weapon bar's bottom, at y=1056. Set the gun name to 20px in --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number for the ammo count.
P2 top-left 'keyboard' chip (x 10-105, y 5-32): Fade it out after 3s, or move it to 24px,24px as a 16px --tx-2 glyph on a --ui-panel chip.

j132-p2-partner-shot.verdict: The HUD is readable but it is still a loose scatter of panels with different edges, fills and margins. Almost none of the earlier layout advice was applied.
findings: P1 top-centre score plate (team score / 0 sp / you / p1 / 10:00): Offset the plate 16px from the top with 16px padding. Set the hero number to 56px f-cond 800. Set the timer to 20px tx-2. Put 'you 0 sp' and 'p1 0 sp' in one 16px row under the hero. Leave 8px between the plate and the extract chip.

P1 left 'player 1' strip (x≈14–170, y≈325–358) and the overhead 'player 1' tag: Move the strip to x=96 or remove it. Colour the name with the P1 amber token at 16px. Make the bars 8px tall. Drop the overhead tag or the strip, not both.

P1 bottom-left vitals (armour 60, hp 100) and the 'f1 controls' chip: Use one 24px bar height for both, 8px apart, at x=96 with the bottom edge at y=1026. Use 16px labels. Put the f1 chip at x=96 directly above the bars, in 16px tx-2 on --ui-panel.

P1 bottom row: party chip, air strike panel, weapon bar, ammo card: Put every panel on a baseline of y=1026 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and the --ui-panel fill. Pull the ammo card in to a 96px right margin. Align the air strike panel's left edge with the weapon bar and leave 16px above the bar. Fold the party chip into the keyboard chip or remove it.
P2 top-left 'keyboard' chip: Move it to (96, 54). Use 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

p1-display.verdict: A clean, consistent card with a clear lime focus, but the right pane is still mostly empty, the focused row has no fill or bar, and the list is dim and crops mid-row at the bottom.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Narrow the pane to about 480px and give the rows the freed width. Or fill it with the current value at 56px hero, the option list with the active one marked, and a 'default: full' line at 16px tx-2. Set the description in 20px f-body tx-1. Drop the lime top border for a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 focused row 'render resolution': Give the focused row a --ui-raised fill, a 3px lime bar on its left edge, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a tx-1 name. Keep the lime value and arrows. Use the same treatment on the tab.

P1 row names and tab labels: Set row names and tabs to 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 for the focused row and tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better for the rest. Raise the row height to 64px, or move the value column in to about x=700. Make the arrows tx-2 so only the focused row's arrows are lime.

P1 scroll list, bottom edge and scrollbar: Add a 32px fade-to-panel mask at the bottom of the list, or snap scroll to whole rows. Make the scrollbar 8px in --ui-line-hi with 8px of margin from the dividers. Align the tabs, list and pane to one top edge at y=116.

P2 title row and footer: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Remove the stub, or run it as a full 3px bar under the title. Put the X in a 40px square with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a focus state. Set the 'esc close' hint at 16px tx-2, and move it onto the footer's left edge, aligned with the tabs.

p1-raid.verdict: The controls list is now one folded 'f1 controls' line and the ammo card has a proper hero number. The HUD is still uneven: panel styles differ, the ammo card and hp bar are mismatched, and the type is small and cramped.
findings: P1 top-left scoreboard (8-367 x 143-242): Collapse it to the 'you' row by default (the caret already exists). When open, use 16px f-cond 600 rows on a 24px pitch with 16px inner padding. Make the title a 16px tx-2 label. Inset the panel 48px from the screen edge, and use tx-1 for 'you' and tx-2 for the bots.

P1 hp bar, bottom left (24-430 x 1034-1068): Put it in a #16191b panel with a 1px #4a5257 border and 4px radius, and inset it 48px from the left and bottom. Make the bar 12px high in --ok, with a 'hp' 16px tx-2 label and a '100' 32px tx-1 number. Align its baseline with the ammo card.

P1 HUD panel styling overall (score, contracts, extract chip, 'c 152m', weapon bar, ammo card): Use one panel recipe: fill #16191b at .88 alpha, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Inset every panel 24px from the screen edge (the score box currently touches y=0). Keep only the selected slot lime.

P1 extract indicators: 'extract 152m' (880-1040 x 87-111), 'c 152m' (1783-1865 x 470-502): Delete the 'c 152m' chip and keep only the edge arrow. Make the top chip a separate 16px teal label 8px below the score panel, not fused to it.
P1 score block (880-1040 x 0-88): Make the timer the hero at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1. Put '0 sp' at 20px tx-2 beside the 'score' label as one 16px line. Give the block 16px padding and a 24px top inset.

p2-display.verdict: The lime value tint on idle rows is gone and the focused row now reads cleanly, but the detail pane is still a huge empty box, the focused row has no fill or bar, and the keyboard chip and the clipped bottom row are untouched.
findings: P1 detail pane (x 1088-1870, y 116-993): Shrink the pane to about 420px and give the list the extra width. Fill the pane with a current-value readout in 56px hero type, plus a short list of the choices with the current one marked. Write a real description at 20px --tx-2, for example 'render the world at full resolution, hud stays sharp'.
P1 focused row 'render resolution' (y 125-180): Fill the focused row with --ui-raised. Add a 3px lime bar on its left edge, matching the tab rail. Keep lime on the value and the chevrons.

P1 value column (chevrons at x 731 and 982, row labels at x 354): Right-align the stepper group at 24px from the list's right edge, with chevrons about 220px apart. Alternatively add a faint hover or focus row fill so the eye can follow across. Make the idle chevrons --tx-2 at 20px.

P2 top-centre 'keyboard' chip (x 912-1007, y 7-31): Move the chip into the header row, right-aligned just left of the X. Give it a --ui-line-hi border and --tx-2 text at 16px. Remove the top-left tick or extend it into a full-width top rule.
P2 bottom of list (y 985-995, 'crosshair size'): Fade the bottom 32px of the list to --ui-panel, or snap the scroll to whole rows. Widen the thumb to 8px in --ui-line-hi.

p2-raid.verdict: The raid screen is much calmer: the controls list is folded to one 'f1 controls' line, the top-centre timer and score block is clear, and the weapon bar and ammo card read well. It still has uneven type sizes, small corner chips and a flat hp bar, so it is short of polished.
findings: P1 top-left leaderboard 'current pillager bots 3' (8-367 x 143-242): Use 16px labels on a 24px row pitch with 16px padding. Make the 'you' row lime with a --ui-raised fill. Set the heading to 16px tx-2. Move the panel to x=48, y=48 and make the chevron a 32px hit target.

P1 hp bar bottom-left (22-430 x 1033-1068): Make the bar 24px high on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, using --ok at low saturation. Align it to a 48px left and bottom margin, matching the ammo card's baseline. Set 'hp' at 16px tx-2 and the number at 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1.

P1 top-centre score block (880-1040 x 0-112): Offset the block 16px from the top. Set the score to 56px f-cond 800 with a 16px tx-2 'sp' suffix. Set the timer to 20px. Leave 8px before the extract chip. Keep a single extract readout.

P1 extract readouts: 'extract 152m' chip (903-1017 x 86-112) and 'c 152m' chip (1783-1892 x 470-503): Keep only the top chip. Turn the right one into a bare 24px teal edge arrow with no text, or drop it. If it stays, use 16px f-cond 600 on a --ui-panel fill with a 4px radius.

P1 top-right 'contracts 0/8 goals 0/3' bar (1603-1900 x 20-53) and area name 'the long dock cache' (1648-1818 x 140-162): Shrink the bar to its content (about 220px) and put it at x=1872-220, y=48 with 16px padding. Set the text to 16px. Give the area name a --ui-panel plate in tx-1 at 20px, or drop the purple.

p1-large.verdict: The hud is clearly tidier: empty hotbar slots are ghosted, the selected slot has a clear outline, hp is the one bold bar and the ammo card is a clean hero number. But the selected slot uses amber where the guide says lime, the panels disagree on width and margin, and the minimap is still half empty.
findings: P1 top-centre score panel: Set the timer to the 56px f-cond 800 hero. Set the score to 20px tx-1 and the you and p2 lines to 16px tx-2 with 24px padding on every side. Leave an 8px gap above the extract chip. Move the weather icon inside the panel or drop it.

P1 right column (minimap, goals, ammo card): Use one 360px column and a 48px right margin for all three blocks. Crop the minimap to its content, for example 360x240. Give each block a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a --ui-panel fill and a 4px radius. Align the ammo card's top and bottom to the same grid.

P1 hotbar selected slot (slot 4): Use a 3px --acc outline and a --ui-raised fill on the selected slot. Give every slot a fixed 72px box on an 8px gap, with the number inside the top-left at 16px tx-2. Drop the empty-slot ghosts to 20% opacity.

P1 bottom-left stat bars (armour, stamina, hp): Make armour and stamina 14px high and hp 20px high, with a 4px gap. Put the labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 above each bar, with the value right-aligned. Reserve the 32px value for hp only. Inset the stack 48px from the left and bottom edges.

P2 player 2 tag (left, y 325-365) and f1 controls hint (y 647-675): Move the player 2 plate to sit directly above the hp stack at the same 48px left inset, 16px label, 8px bar. Place the f1 controls hint at bottom-centre-left, with its baseline 8px above the hotbar, in a --ui-panel pill.

p1-large-half.verdict: The HUD is still drawn into a 960x540 box in the middle of a black 1920x1080 frame, with tiny type. The 'hp 100' label is still the boldest thing on screen, and the ammo card is still crowded against the corner.
findings: P0 whole frame (480,270 to 1440,810): Render the canvas at the full 1920x1080 with 96x54px margins. Apply the size multiplier (large = 1.25x) to the 1080 base, so labels reach 16px and body text 20px. Check that 'large' actually changes the result.

P0 top-centre score block (890,280 to 1030,350), extract chip (928,357), minimap (1250,280 to 1430,488): Move the score block 24px below the top edge. Set '0 sp' to 56px f-cond 800 and the timer to 32px. Set the labels to 16px tx-2. Put the extract chip 16px below the block, at 16px with 8px padding. Inset the minimap 48px from the right and top, and crop or fill its empty lower half. Give 'goals' a 16px label with 8px padding.

P1 bottom-left bars (493,740 to 737,804): Make all three bars 12px high with an 8px gap. Put the labels outside the bars at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, with the values at 20px tx-1. Keep hp green but drop the bold. Inset the stack 48px from the left and bottom edges.

P1 ammo card (1300,704 to 1436,773): Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom edges. Align its right edge with the minimap's. Set the weapon name to 16px tx-2 and the ammo to 56px f-cond 800, with '/ 42' at 20px tx-2.

P1 hotbar (796,609 to 1058,670): Draw all slots as 64px tiles on a --ui-raised fill with a 1px --ui-line border. Give only the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Add a 3px rarity bar at the bottom. Set the slot numbers to 14px tx-2 and the counts to 16px tx-1. Put 16px between the hotbar and the player.

p1-standard.verdict: The hud is readable and the ammo hero number lands well, but the margins are still 0 to 24px (not 48) and the corners don't line up. The vitals bars are still uneven, the hotbar is cluttered, and the top-centre box is cramped.
findings: P1 bottom-left vitals (armour/stamina/hp): Move the cluster to 48px from the left and bottom edges. Give the three bars the same 20px height, 8px gap and 4px radius, on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line border. Put the labels in 16px tx-1 on the left and the numbers right-aligned. Make hp the only 56px f-cond 800 number, or drop the hero from hp since ammo already has one.

P1 hotbar (slots 1-0 and 5/6): Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with an 8px gap on --ui-panel at 4px radius. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc outline with a 2px offset. Set numbers and ammo to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1. Centre the row and lift it 48px from the bottom.

P1 bottom edge alignment (vitals, hotbar, ammo card): Put all three clusters on the same 48px bottom margin, with the left and right clusters 48px from their screen edges. Make the ammo card the same height as the hotbar tiles (about 72px), right edge at x=1872.

P1 top-centre team score box: Set the score to 32px f-cond 800, the timer to 20px, and the you/p2 lines to 16px tx-2. Pad the box 16px. Merge the extract pill into the box as a bottom row separated by a 1px --ui-line. Put the weather glyph inside the box at 16px.

P1 top-right minimap and goals bar: Inset the map 48px from the top and right. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both the map and goals panels. Move the chevron into the goals header. Crop the map to the explored area or fill it. Set the goals label to 16px f-cond 600.

p2-large.verdict: The hotbar now shows only the two owned slots with a clear active ring, and the ammo block is a strong hero number. The rest of the HUD is still uneven: the top panel is flush against the screen edge, the three bars each have a different height, and the bottom-left corner is crowded.
findings: P1 hotbar, x365-1450, y680-800: Remove the ghost silhouettes and the idle digits. Keep the two cards on one 8px-grid gap (16px). Dock the bar 32px above the bottom edge, so the card bottoms land near y1048. Show a key digit only inside a card.

P1 top-centre team score panel, x822-1098, y20-162: Left-align one column: 56px f-cond 800 '0 sp' with the 32px timer under it, and the 16px tx-2 'you / p1' rows on the right. Use 8px between the panel and the extract pill, 4px radius everywhere, and the same --scrim fill as the minimap panel.

P1 bottom-left bars, x28-516, y943-1068: Set all three bars to 24px with a 4px gap and 16-20px f-cond labels at 8px left padding. Fill hp with --ok at about 80% and switch to --danger below 30%. Drop the hp label to 20px. Remove or merge the duplicate 'player 1' card.
P2 'f1 controls' hint, x226-346, y647-675: Anchor it at x32, 16px above the top of the hp stack (y~920). Use a 16px tx-2 label and an 'f1' chip with a --ui-line-hi border on --scrim at .80.

P2 minimap and goals, x1540-1900, y20-435: Crop the minimap to its used area or fill it. Use a 32px margin everywhere. Give goals the same 4px radius and --scrim fill as the other panels. Make the compass icons 16px minimum.

p2-large-half.verdict: The HUD is still a small 960x540 window inside a black 1920x1080 frame, so the large-HUD setting is not shown to work, and inside the window the HUD is still small and has hierarchy problems.
findings: P0 whole frame (game window 480-1440 x 270-810): Render the capture at the full 1920x1080. Make the 'large' preset scale every HUD element by about 1.5x, so the 20px body text is 30px and the 16px labels are 24px. Re-shoot with the setting on.

P1 top-centre score panel (891-1029 x 280-351): Set '0 sp' at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1. Set the timer at 20px tx-2. Set the sub-scores at 16px, with you in amber and p2 in cyan. Use 16px padding and move the panel 24px from the top. Do not show both 'you' and 'p1', since that is the same value twice.

P1 bottom-left bars (armour 40 / stamina / hp 100, 493-737 x 742-805): Give all three bars a uniform 12px height with 8px gaps. Set the labels at 16px tx-1 on a --ui-panel plate. Show hp at 56px in f-cond 800, with its bar thin (8px). Move the block 48px in from the left and bottom edges.

P1 weapon hotbar (729-1060 x 608-670): Show only owned slots. Make them 72px square with 8px gaps, in one contiguous row centred at the bottom, 24px from the bottom edge. Set slot numbers at 16px tx-2. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc bottom bar and a --ui-raised fill. Remove the ghost icons and the digit row.

P1 ammo card (1309-1435 x 704-773): Align the card's bottom edge with the hp bar's bottom edge, and sit it 48px from the right and bottom edges. Set 'compact smg' at 16px tx-2, left-aligned. Keep the number at 56px. Use a 4px radius and 16px padding.

p2-standard.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the corner groups sit on ragged margins, the hotbar is nearly invisible against the street, and the vitals bars and score panel are still not tidied the way last review asked.
findings: P1 bottom-left vitals (x22-430, y965-1070): Make every row 24px tall with an 8px gap and a 4px radius on a --ui-panel track. Put 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 labels outside the fill, with the value right-aligned. Keep hp as the only emphasised row, at 20px 700. Inset the block 48px left and 32px bottom.

P1 hotbar (x550-1558, y953-1062): Draw all 10 slots as 56x56 --ui-panel tiles with 8px gaps, with empties at 40% opacity. Selected state is a 2px player-colour outline plus a --ui-raised fill. Set numbers and counts at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, and the selected slot's number in tx-1. Align the bottom edge to y=1048.

P1 top-centre score panel (x845-1075, y17-135) and extract pill (y145-170): Make the 56px hero the sp number only. Move the timer to 20px 700 on its own row, or to the panel's right side. Set 'you' and 'p1' at 16px tx-2. Give the panel 16px padding. Put 8px between the panel and the pill. Give the pill a 1px --extract border and 16px text. Move the weather icon inside the panel's right edge.

P2 edge margins (minimap x1603-1903, ammo panel x1705-1910, vitals x22, player 1 tag x15): Use one safe area: 48px left and right, 32px top and bottom. Align the ammo panel's bottom edge to the hotbar baseline at y=1048.

P2 minimap and goals row (x1603-1903, y17-362): Join the map and the goals row into one panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between them. Align the count right at 16px f-cond 600 and shrink the chevron to 12px.

condition-sp-extracted-guest.verdict: It is a clean, readable result card with a clear lime primary action. But it holds too much for one screen, the stats are inconsistent (kills appears twice), the small text is below the guide's size floor, and the amber and teal blocks compete with the lime button.
findings: P1 Whole card, below the two total boxes: Cut it to hero, two panels, one medal row and the primary action. Move the stat strip and the feedback toggle off this screen, or fold them into the panels. Use 16px gaps between groups and 24px between sections.

P1 Hero numbers: '2,000 sp' and '$2,520': Make the score total a single 56px f-cond 800 hero in tx-1 or lime. Drop the money total to the 20px body size in tx-1. Keep amber for the 3px rarity bar only.
P1 Gem tile under the panels (959,489): Label it, or move it into the money panel as an item row, or delete it.
P1 Stat strip: kills, accuracy, containers, time, health: Use 16px labels with +.04em tracking and 28px values. Drop the duplicate kills tile. Show 3 tiles at most.
P2 Two panels, row text and dividers: Make labels tx-2 at 16px weight 600. Make values tx-1 at 20px weight 700. Use a --ui-line divider.

condition-sp-extracted-host.verdict: The card is tidy and the lime leaderboard button reads as the main action, but it holds too many stacked elements, the stats contradict the score, the type is tiny, and the amber, teal, gold and lime colours compete.
findings: P1 stat chips row (kills 0, accuracy 0%, containers 0, time 0:00, health 100): Remove the row, or fix the values. If it stays, drop the duplicate kills chip and use real values at 20px for the number and 16px for the label.
P1 hierarchy, the whole card: Make the 2,000 sp total the single hero at 56px, f-cond 800. Drop $2,520 to 32px in tx-1. Keep the title at 32px.

P1 labels and captions: stat chip labels, medal names, 'out clean · never spotted', 'personal best', +148 xp: Set every label to 16px minimum, 600 weight. Use tx-1 for the xp line at 20px. Delete the 'out clean · never spotted' explaining sentence.

P1 colour use: amber score panel, teal money panel, gold medals, lime button: Make both panels --ui-panel with a --ui-line-hi border. Use tx-1 for the values, with lime only on the hero total. Keep teal only on the 'extracted' title. Use a 3px rarity-gold bar on the medals, with no fill.

P1 vertical rhythm, between the gem tile, stat chips, medals, xp, feedback button and leaderboard: Remove the unlabelled gem tile or give it a name. Put gaps on the 8px grid at 24px between groups. Make the content column the full card width minus 48px padding.

finalrush-host-raid.verdict: The final rush banner is now a wide red-edged panel, but the top-centre stack is still a pile of overlapping boxes, the HUD uses inconsistent type sizes, and the bottom-left and bottom-right clusters are untouched.
findings: P1 final rush banner (x650-1270, y265-390): Shrink the banner to about 420px wide with 16px padding. Centre it on x=960 and put it at y=260 with 24px of clear space above and below. Fill it with --ui-panel at 90% opacity. Use a 4px --danger left bar and drop the partial bottom line. Set the title to 32px --danger and the subline to 20px tx-2. Remove the 'the seal' text from behind it.

P1 top-centre stack (extract chip, timer, weather icon, team score): Use one 16px gap between all boxes and centre each on x=960. Make the timer the only 56px hero. Put the extract chip on the left of the timer at the same top edge and the weather icon on the right. Make the team score box the same width as the timer row. Show 'team score' as a 16px tx-2 label above one 20px row, with 'you' and 'p2' left-aligned at 16px tx-2.

P1 bottom-left bars (armour 60, hp 100) and f1 controls chip: Use one 16px label and one 20px value format for both bars. Make both bars 32px high and 400px wide, stacked with an 8px gap and left edge at x=48. Put each label on a dark --ui-panel plate. Set the f1 chip's left edge at x=48 on its own row 16px above the bars.

P1 bottom-right ammo panel (x1605-1910, y868-1017): Inset the panel 48px from the right and bottom edges. Cap the ammo count at 56px f-cond 800 and the weapon name at 20px. Move the weapon slot tiles to sit directly left of the ammo panel on the same baseline.

P2 weapon slots 1-0 on the bottom strip: Draw all 10 slots as equal 64px tiles with a --ui-line border and --ui-panel fill. Put the number in a 16px label inside each tile. Dim empty tiles to 40% opacity. Give the selected tile a 3px --acc border.

finalrush-partner-raid.verdict: The top-centre is now a clear timer-then-banner hierarchy with consistent dark panels, but the final rush banner is oversized and mostly empty, the team score box has uneven alignment, and the bottom-left bars still sit loose on the map.
findings: P1 final rush banner, centre: Shrink it to fit its content, about 320x72px, with 16px padding. Keep the 4px red left bar, put the warning glyph and 'final rush' on one line at 20-24px, and put 'kills x1.05 sp' at 16px in tx-2. Anchor it 16px under the team score panel.

P1 team score panel, below the timer: Make the panel the same width as the timer, or 220px. Use a two-column grid with a shared baseline: 210 sp at 32px tx-1 on the left, and 'you 105' and 'player 2 105' at 16px on the right. Use 8px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius.

P1 bottom-left armour 60 and hp 100 bars: Put both in one --ui-panel container with a 4px radius and 8px padding. Make both bars 20px tall with 20px f-cond 600 labels. Use --ok for hp. Right-align the numbers on a dark track. Align the container left edge with the weapon slots at a 5% margin.

P1 weapon slot row, 1 to 0: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles with --ui-panel at 85% fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Keep the numbers at 16px in tx-2. Make the selected tile's border 2px --acc lime, and set ammo counts at 16px tx-1. Align the bottoms of the slot row and the ammo panel.

P2 top-right goals 0/3 panel: Drop the 'run goals' line, and align the three goal rows to one left edge at 16px. Right-align the '+400 sp' rewards in tx-2. Collapse the panel to just 'goals 0/3' by default and open it with a key. Set the panel inset to 24px to match the HUD margin.

l155-p1-day.verdict: The HUD is still a pile of unrelated widgets: the hp bar and chips are crammed into the bottom edge, the two top-left dropdowns still don't line up, and the timer is not the hero. The earlier fixes were mostly not applied.
findings: P1 bottom-left hp bar and status chips, 24-430 x 940-1068: Move the block to y=1000 or higher, which gives a 54px bottom margin. Draw 'hp' at 16px tx-2 and '100' at 32px f-cond 700 over a 12px bar with a 4px radius. Make the chips one 16px row of icon plus word with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Reserve --danger for real damage.

P1 top-left dropdowns 'current pillagers 0' (8-367 x 143-260) and 'run info' (1603-1900 x 18-55), plus the 'pillager' bar (14-170 x 325-358): Make both dropdowns 360x40, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --ui-panel at 85% fill and 16px f-cond 600 text, with a 54px margin and the same y=24. Delete the left 'pillager' bar.

P1 top-centre timer, 'extract 74m' and the extraction label, 920-1015 x 10-72 and 1630-1780 x 465-488: Set the timer to 56px f-cond 800 tx-1 and shrink the sun to 20px. Keep 'extract 74m' as a single 20px teal chip. Fix the string to 'extraction c available' with the right spelling, and make it 16px with a 4px radius and the same chip style.

P1 ammo card, 1668-1910 x 902-1052: Inset the card to a 54px right margin. Put 'b / i backpack' at 16px tx-2 (4.5:1). Draw the silhouette at 100% in the left half. Set '/ 24' at 32px tx-2 so '12' is the only hero.

P2 hotbar, 553-1060 x 955-1058: Draw every slot as a 100x100 tile with a 4px radius, 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Set numerals at 16px tx-2. Dim empty slots to 50%. Keep the selected slot amber for P1.

l155-p1-night.verdict: The ammo panel and weapon slots are solid, but the previous round's fixes were mostly not applied: the hp bar is still oversized, the top-left debug-style dropdowns and the pillager bar are still there, and the chips are still inconsistent.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left (24,1035)-(430,1068): Make the bar 320x16px at x=48, with a 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 'hp 100' label above it. Use --ok at about 80% saturation and a 1px --ui-line track. Leave 24px above it.

P1 top-left 'keyboard' tag (10,8), 'current pillagers 0' dropdown (8,142)-(367,170), top-right 'run info' dropdown (1603,19)-(1901,55): Use --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px/600 label and 16px padding. Align to x=48 and y=48. Fold 'current pillagers 0' into the run info dropdown. Hide the keyboard tag after 3s.
P1 'pillager' bar, left (14,325)-(168,355): Delete it. If a squad panel is needed, put it at x=48 with a 16px label and an 8px-high hp bar inside a --ui-panel card.
P1 'the long dock cache' (1447,130): Set it in tx-1, 20px f-cond 600, in a --ui-panel chip at 80% alpha with 8px/12px padding. Place it top-centre under the 'extract 74m' chip and fade it after 3s.

P1 chips: 'extract 74m' (905,47), 'extraction c available' (1630,467), 'pillager joined' (895,893), 'f1 controls' (437,930): Use one chip: --ui-panel fill, 3px left bar in the meaning colour (extract teal), 16px/600 text, 8px/12px padding. Fix the spelling or shorten it to 'extract c'. Move 'pillager joined' to the left feed.

l155-p2-day.verdict: The in-raid HUD is still a set of unrelated floating pieces, and almost none of the earlier fixes have landed. The bottom row has no shared edge, the top-left stack has no panel, and the empty slots 3 to 0 sit on the map unframed.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Put hp on a --ui-panel plate with 16px padding, a 4px radius and a bottom margin of 24px. Make the bar 16px high and 280px wide. Put the 'hp' label in tx-2 at 16px and the '100' in tx-1 at 28px beside or above the bar, not on the green. Keep the bar 16px clear of the slot row.

P1 bottom row: f1 controls, slots, party chip, ammo card: Use one 24px bottom margin so hp, slots and ammo all end at y=1056, with 24px side margins. Left-align 'f1 controls' over the hp plate at x=24. Move the party chip into the left feed or the top-left panel, in the same --ui-panel style.

P1 top-left stack: keyboard tag, current pillagers dropdown, pillager name bar: Use one --ui-panel at x=24, y=24 with 16px padding and a 4px radius. Put the device tag, the 'current pillagers 0' row and the self row inside it. Make text 20px tx-1 for names and 16px tx-2 for labels. Use amber for P1. Drop the chevron.

P1 run info dropdown, top-right: Shrink it to a hugging chip: a 16px tx-2 'run info' label, a 16px chevron, 8px 16px padding, --ui-panel, a 4px radius, and 24px from the top and right edges. Use the same style as the left dropdown. Make the label lower case.

P1 weapon slots 3 to 0: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles at 70% fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap. Put the number in the top-left at 16px tx-2. Make the active tile's border 2px lime --acc. Delete the 'f' badge.

l155-p2-night.verdict: The HUD has an ammo card and slot tiles now, but the raw browser dropdowns, the off-grid hp bar and the crowded top-centre cluster from last review are all still here, so it still reads as a debug overlay on a good-looking map.
findings: P0 top-right 'run Info' select (x1603-1900, y20-54) and left 'current pillagers 0' select (x8-367, y142-172): Hide all three in a career raid. If they stay, make them --ui-panel chips with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2 text, and a 16px chevron. Set the text to 'run info', inset them to x96 and y54, and move 'keyboard' into the same chip style.

P1 bottom-left hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1068): Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, inset to x96 and y(1080-54). Make the bar 24px tall with --ok fill, and set 'hp 100' to 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 with 8px padding. Left-align the card with the 'f1 controls' hint.

P1 weapon slots (x553-770 filled, 3-0 empty, y955-1060): Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles on an 8px gap, with a 1px --ui-line border. Show empty slots at 40% opacity. Make the selected border 2px --acc. Set slot numbers to 16px --tx-2. Move the party chip off the strip, to y888 at x96.

P1 top-centre cluster (x905-1035, y10-95): Put the timer in a --ui-panel plate, 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1. Put 'extract 70m' under it as a 16px --extract label with a 1px --extract border, at the same width. Move the arrow inside the pill at 16px. Align the moon icon inside the plate.

P1 ammo card (x1668-1910, y902-1052): Inset the card to x1824 (96px margin). Right-align all three rows to a 24px inner padding. Set 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2. Keep 12 at 56px f-cond 800 and make '/ 24' 32px --tx-2.
